entries.title: About the Compendium
entries.body: This Compendium book collects together all of the special traits, weapon special rules and effects that make the Batman Miniature Game so compelling and tactically diverse. You’ll require a copy of the Batman Miniature Game 3rd Edition rulebook to use the contents of this compendium.

entries.title: Special Modifiers
entries.body:
It’s important to differentiate between three types of modifiers:
• + X Ex. Attack: Means that the model gains a + X to the character characteristic.
• + X dice of Ex. Attack: Means that the model gains X extra dice when attacking (but the attribute is not modified).
• + X to its Ex. Attack roll: Means that the model gains an X bonus to the results of its Attack dice (it doesn’t modify its attribute or the number of dice that it rolls).

entries.title: Special Traits
entries.body:
Traits provide models with various special rules. These are an exception to the basic rules and always take precedence over them where there is a conflict. In order to benefit from a trait, the model must, of course, possess it (it will be listed on the model’s Character Card). Additionally, some traits require you to spend a Special action to activate the ability – these will be denoted clearly by the appearance of the Bat-Symbol ().
When a model activates a trait, it only benefits from that trait’s effect during its own activation, unless otherwise specified. Finally, if a trait affects friendly models within a certain range, the model using the trait is also included, unless otherwise specified.

entries.title: One Use Only
entries.body:
(ONCE PER ROUND, ONCE PER GAME)
Many traits contain these sentences at the beginning of their description. This simply means that the model may use this trait only once per game, once per round...

entries.title: Doses
entries.body: Several traits contain the keyword ‘Dose’. This simply means that the model can use the trait once for each Dose it possesses. For example, if a model has 2 Venom Doses, it can use it twice during the game. Each time a model gains a Dose, it may use the ability one more time if the model is able to do so. A model may only use one Dose per round.

entries.title: Keywords
entries.body: Some traits (such as Cop and Criminal) don’t have any special rules at all – these are known as ‘keywords’. Other rules and traits reference these keywords, but they don’t do anything on their own.

entries.title: Dodging
entries.body: A model that benefits from this rule may make an Effort to reduce the attack dice from a Ranged Attack that targets this model.

entries.title: Special Markers
entries.body:
Some of the traits and other special rules in this compendium grant one or more special markers to a model. These represent various temporary bonuses. If a model receives more than one special marker of the same type, the effects are cumulative. Markers must be used and discarded the first time the model performs the action of the specified type.
• Attack Marker +: A model with one or more + markers gains one extra attack die in its next Melee Attack action for each marker it possesses. A model cannot have more than 3 + markers at any one time.
• Defense Marker: A model with one or more markers gains one extra die to its next Defense roll for each marker it possesses. A model cannot have more than 3 markers at any one time.
• Movement Boost Marker: A model with a marker adds +2 +2 a number of inches to its basic move distance for its next Movement action, equal to value on the marker. These markers aren’t cumulative, when a model receives a marker with a higher value, it replaces the lower value marker.
• Movement Penalty Marker: A model with one marker 2 2 deducts a number of inches from its basic move distance for its next Movement action, equal to the value on the marker, to a minimum of 0. These markers aren’t cumulative, when a model receives a marker with a higher value, it replaces the lower value marker.
Note that Movement Boost and Movement Penalty markers counter each other (so a model with a +6” from boost marker and -4” from penalty marker would gain a +2” bonus to its next Movement action).
There are also markers known as Numeric Counters, that markers contain ever a number between the 1 and 6. It cannot be increased below 6, but can reach 0, when it happens, the Numeric Counter is removed.

entries.title: Attack Marker
entries.body: A model with one or more Attack markers gains one extra attack die in its next Melee Attack action for each marker it possesses. A model cannot have more than 3 Attack markers at any one time.

entries.title: Defense Marker
entries.body: A model with one or more Defense markers gains one extra die to its next Defense roll for each marker it possesses. A model cannot have more than 3 Defense markers at any one time.

entries.title: Movement Boost Marker
entries.body: A Movement Boost marker adds its value in inches to the model’s basic move distance for its next Movement action. These markers are not cumulative; a higher value replaces a lower one.

entries.title: Movement Penalty Marker
entries.body: A Movement Penalty marker deducts its value in inches from the model’s basic move distance for its next Movement action, to a minimum of 0. These markers are not cumulative; a higher value replaces a lower one.

entries.title: Numeric Counter
entries.body: A Numeric Counter contains a number between 1 and 6. It cannot be increased above 6, but can reach 0; when it reaches 0, remove it.

entries.title: A Challenge for you
entries.body: Every time your crew places a Suspect, you must place a Numeric Counter on it. You decide the number on the counter, unless a card or ability specifies the number. These Numeric Counters cannot be reduced below 0.

entries.title: Absolute Power
entries.body: If this model is your crew’s Boss, you can hire Henchmen with the Cop trait, regardless of their Affiliation. In addition, this model doubles the range of its Inspire rule.

entries.title: Acrobat
entries.body: This model gains +1” to its basic move distance. It does not suffer Impaired Movement for Jumping, or for Stand Up actions. Models with Acrobat can use the Dodging rule.

entries.title: Adaptable
entries.body: At the beginning of the Raise the Plan phase, the player controlling this model must choose between the Attack (+1), Defense (+1) or Movement (+2) basic skills. The model receives the bonus to the chosen skill until the end of the round.

entries.title: Addict
entries.body: This model suffers -1 to its Attacks and Defense skills unless it uses a Dose. As soon as the model uses a Dose, the penalties cease to apply until the end of the round.

entries.title: Affinity (Model)
entries.body: This model may be recruited by any crew that also includes the model named in parentheses, even if they would not ordinarily be permitted to join that crew. This model may treat its rank as Free Agent for the purposes of forming the crew (but cannot use the Free agent rank during the game). Recruiting this model does not allow a further use of the trait (if, for example, another character has an Affinity to this model).

entries.title: Agent of Chaos
entries.body: When friendly models within 4” of this model activate, they may take an Audacity marker from a friendly model that is yet to activate.

entries.title: Agent of Order
entries.body: Friendly models within 4” cannot lose Actions because of an opponent’s rules.

entries.title: Light Radiance
entries.body: When this model uses the Medic trait it affects all friendly models within 2”.

entries.title: Aggressive Schizophrenia (Mental Disorder)
entries.body: If this model is in contact with another model (friend or foe) at the beginning of its activation, it gains an extra Attack action, which must immediately be performed against one model in contact. Once this attack is resolved, this model may continue its turn normally.

entries.title: Agile
entries.body: This model can’t suffer Falling Damage. However, if the result of the Fall is to remove the model from the game, it is still made a Casualty.

entries.title: Air Combat
entries.body: If this model uses the Batclaw trait or Falls during its activation, then for the remainder of the activation it gains a +1 bonus to its attack and Strength rolls, and triggers CRTs on a natural roll of 4+ when performing Melee Attacks.

entries.title: Air Support
entries.body: Place the Explosive template anywhere on the board. During this round, the area under the template is under the effect of Lights.

entries.title: Amazon
entries.body: This model receives a +1 bonus to its attack and Defense rolls. In addition, enemy models roll 1 less attack die when targeting this model.

entries.title: Alpha
entries.body: This model’s Attacks and Defense skills cannot be reduced below 4 by any means.

entries.title: Always on the Move
entries.body: This model can interrupt its Movement action to perform an Attack action, and then continue with its Movement action. The model must have enough actions available to use this trait.

entries.title: Amazon Lineage
entries.body: If this model is your crew’s Boss, you can only recruit models with Affiliation:. TM TM

entries.title: Amazon Princess
entries.body: This model automatically gains the Charge trait. However, targets of this model’s Charge incur a -1 penalty to their Defense rolls. While this Upgrade Character Card is added to Wonder Woman, she cannot use the Bracelets of Submission trait or the Lasso of Hestia weapon, and does not benefit from the effects of her Magic Shield.

entries.title: Amphibious
entries.body: This model does not suffer Impaired Movement when moving through Difficult Ground elements that are considered water (i. e. rivers, swamps, canals, ponds, etc.). Players should agree on what counts as a water feature before the game begins. In addition, this Model can enter a Sewer without performing a Manipulate action.

entries.title: Anger Management (Mental disorder)
entries.body: When performing a Ranged Attack, this model must always select the closest model in line of sight, friend or enemy, as the target.

entries.title: Animal
entries.body: This model gains a bonus of +2” to its basic move distance. When it moves, it can ignore obstacles up to 2” high, but cannot Climb or Jump. If this model suffers the Fire effect, during the Recount phase (before resolving the effect) make a Willpower roll (which cannot be rerolled). If this roll is failed, the model cannot move in the following round. This model cannot purchase equipment.

entries.title: Anxiety (Mental Disorder)
entries.body: This model gains +2” to its basic move distance, but must perform a Movement action during its activation if the model can do it.

entries.title: Archie
entries.body: This model is not deployed as normal at the start of the game. Once per game, at the start of the Raise the Plan phase of any round, you may place this model anywhere on the table (not inside a building or within a similarly enclosed space).

entries.title: Arkham Asylum Doctor
entries.body: All friendly models with a Mental Disorder trait within 4” of this model gain 1 extra Tactical Action.

entries.title: Arrest
entries.body: When in contact with a KO enemy model (not a Vehicle), this model may immediately remove the KO model from the game as a Casualty.

entries.title: Arrogant
entries.body: When this model performs an Attack against a model with a lower Reputation cost than its own, it rolls one less attack die.

entries.title: Arsenal
entries.body: After deployment, this model may equip up to one Hands equipment card, and one Back equipment card. These cards cannot be equipped in any other way, and cannot be cancelled by an opponen.

entries.title: Assassin X
entries.body: If this model removes an enemy model as a Casualty, you may pick 1 Objective card from the Spent Resource pile with a maximum Victory Points value of X, and then add that card to your hand.

entries.title: Assistance
entries.body: While a friendly Robin (Boy Wonder) is in play, this model gains +1 Willpower. If a friendly Robin (Boy Wonder) is removed as a Casualty, this model gains +1 Strength until the end of the game.

entries.title: Atomica
entries.body: When this model attacks an enemy model (not a Vehicle), the enemy model must pass a Willpower roll before any attack dice are rolled. If it fails, it suffers -1 Defense until the end of the round.

entries.title: Attorney’s Allegation
entries.body: One Use Only. All friendly Henchman within 8” gain 1 extra Action.

entries.title: Autorepair X
entries.body: At the beginning of the Recount phase, this model rolls 1D6. On a result of X+ remove a Damage marker (any type) from this model.

entries.title: Aversion X
entries.body: This model cannot be included in the same crew as the specified model.

entries.title: Backpack
entries.body: This model can perform a Reveal Manipulate action once per activation without spending an Action.

entries.title: Bat-Armor Mk I
entries.body: Enemy models don’t roll a Strength die when attacking this model.

entries.title: Bat-Armor Mk II
entries.body: This model ignores enemy Strength dice unless the roll is a natural 6. In addition, this model gains +1” to its basic move distance.

entries.title: Bat-Armor Mk III
entries.body: Enemy models don’t roll a Strength die when attacking this model. In addition, if this model has moved this activation, it can make Melee Attacks against enemies up to 2” away in line of sight (ignore all traits that improve the model’s line of sight, such as Total Vision, for the purpose of these attacks).

entries.title: Bat Cape
entries.body: This model does not take Damage, nor can it be removed as a Casualty, as a result of Falling.

entries.title: Batclaw
entries.body: Once per round, this model gains +6” to its basic move distance, and can move in any direction (including vertically). When using this ability, the model can move over obstacles and Difficult Ground without penalty. However, the model cannot use this rule in two consecutive activations. *Some models list this trait as ‘Grapple Gun’, and others as ‘Batclaw’. The rules are the same in both instances - the distinction is just for fun!

entries.title: Batman Lives
entries.body: This model may perform an extra Movement action at the start of its activation if no enemy models have LoS to it. When in contact with a KO enemy model that does not have Affiliation:, this model may remove it as a Casualty by spending a Special Action. In addition, when this model is included in your crew, you can also include a model with Name: William Cobb (ignoring its Affiliation), but if you do so you may not include any model with the Free Agent rank unless it also has Affiliation:.

entries.title: Batman’s Tumbler
entries.body: This model can neither Jump nor Climb. When the Upgrade Card becomes disabled, you can immediately exchange this Upgrade Card with the Batman’s Batpod Upgrade card.

entries.title: Bat-Signal
entries.body: One use only. This model can use this trait to place a friendly model (not KO or Knocked Down) with Alias: Batman in contact with itself. Until the end of that round, this model is considered Illuminated.

entries.title: Bipolar (Mental Disorder)
entries.body: At the beginning of this model’s activation, roll a die or flip a coin. If the result is even/heads, this model may make 1 Effort this round without taking a [[B]] marker. If the result is odd/tails, this model suffers the Enervating 1 effect.

entries.title: Biting
entries.body: Enemies within 6” that wish to perform an Action must first suffer the Enervating 1 effect. If they already have Enervating, they must instead increase their Enervating value by 1.

entries.title: Blood Scent
entries.body: When targeting a model with at least 1 [[A]] marker with an Attack, this model gains +1 to its attack dice rolls, +1 to the Strength roll, and gains the Bleed 1 effect.

entries.title: Bloodthirsty (Mental Disorder)
entries.body: During the Raise the Plan phase, if this model has at least 1 Damage marker of any kind, it gains +1 +.

entries.title: Boosted Jump
entries.body: One use only. During this model activation, place this model within 8” of its start position.

entries.title: Bluff
entries.body: Choose an enemy model within 6” and line of sight. The target reduces its Attacks skill by 1 until the end of the round. If multiple models with this trait target the same model, the effect is not cumulative.

entries.title: Bodyguard
entries.body: If a friendly model with the Leader or Sidekick rank within 4” of this model and LoS suffers any number of hits from an Attack (of any kind), this model may make an Effort to take the hits instead, and all the effects of that attack. Only one Effort [[B]] is required per enemy Attack.

entries.title: Bonebreaker
entries.body: Until the end of the round, this model’s unarmed attacks gain Bleed: 2.

entries.title: Boom!
entries.body: Each time this model receives any damage, roll a D6 – on the natural score of a 6, this model explodes! Alternatively, during its activation, you may choose to make this model explode. When the model explodes, center an Explosive template on it. Roll a Strength 3+ die against each model affected. On a success, the model suffers [[A]] [[A]] [[B]] Damage. After resolving the explosion, remove this model as a Casualty.

entries.title: Born in the Darkness
entries.body: When this model is not within the area effect of a Light source, it gains a +1 bonus to its Defense rolls, and enemy models cannot benefit from the Sneak Attack trait when targeting this model.

entries.title: Boss’s Orders
entries.body: All friendly Henchmen that attack an enemy model within 8” of this model gain +1 to their attack dice rolls in close combat until the end of the round.

entries.title: Bot Bomb
entries.body: Choose one of your models with the Bot trait to explode. Center the Explosion template over the bot. Roll a Strength 4+ die against each model affected. On a success, the model suffers [[A]] [[A]] Damage. Once the trait is resolved, remove the Bot as a Casualty.

entries.title: Bot
entries.body: This model cannot recover from KO or recover Stun damage in the Recount phase. However, attacks with the Firearm, Mechanical and Beam rule deduct 1 attack die when rolling against this model. In addition, this model cannot use Doses of any kind, and is immune to the Enervating, Hypnotize, Poison, Scared and Terror effects.

entries.title: Bot Mechanic
entries.body: Target a model with the Bot trait within 4” and Line of Sight. Remove up to 3 Damage markers from that model.

entries.title: Boy Wonder
entries.body: Enemy models cannot reroll attack dice against this model granted by the Handy rule.

entries.title: Bracelets of submission
entries.body: The first time this model is selected as a target by an enemy ranged attack in each round, it reduces the attacker’s RoF by -1.

entries.title: Brutal
entries.body: This model scores Critical results on a natural roll of 5 or 6.

entries.title: Bullet Time
entries.body: One use only. After activating this trait, if this model performs a Ranged Attack, it gains an extra Ranged Attack action. The model cannot use the same ranged weapon more than once. This model doesn’t lose attack dice this round for firing after moving.

entries.title: Bulletproof Vest
entries.body: Traits and attacks with the Firearm rule deduct 1 attack die when rolling against this model.

entries.title: Business Agent
entries.body: When this model is recruited, add $350 to the crew’s available Funding.

entries.title: Canary Cry
entries.body: Place the Spray template in base contact with this model – all models affected receive one automatic hit with the Sonic special rule. Affected models must pass a Willpower roll or take [[A]] Damage and become Stunned.

entries.title: Cannibal
entries.body: When this model removes an enemy model (not a Vehicle) as a Casualty in Melee, remove up to 2 Damage markers (any type) from its character card.

entries.title: Can you solve this? X
entries.body: Once per round, this model may move up to 4” a suspect marker within 4” during its activation by rolling a +X result in a die roll.

entries.title: Carry
entries.body: If this model passes within 2” of one or more friendly models during a Movement Action, it may make an Effort and target one of those models and place it in base contact at the end of the move. The chosen model cannot have the Large or Huge traits. The target model suffers Impaired Movement during its next activation unless it is Damian Wayne. This model cannot use the Carry trait in two consecutive activations.

entries.title: Catcher Gear
entries.body: Enemies attacking this model never benefit from the Heavy weapon special rule.

entries.title: Chain of Command
entries.body: When its crew’s Boss becomes a Casualty, this model immediately becomes the new Boss, taking the. This model does not halve the range of the Inspire trait when taking over as Boss. If more than one model in the crew has this trait, or another trait with the same effect (such as Hidden Boss) the controlling player must choose between them.

entries.title: Chill Touch
entries.body: Unarmed Melee Attacks made by this model deal [[A]] and gain CRT: Cooled.

entries.title: Chaotic Friends
entries.body: Friendly models with the Gotham City Siren trait in this model’s crew gain the Unpredictable rule until the end of the game.

entries.title: Charge
entries.body: This trait must be activated before the model moves during its activation. During a Movement action this activation, this model may only move in a straight line. Roll 1 Strength die for each model contacted during this move, inflicting Damage [[B]] [[B]] . Any other damage the model could normally inflict is ignored.

entries.title: Charismatic
entries.body: A crew that includes this model can recruit 1 additional Free Agent, ignoring the usual restrictions.

entries.title: Charm
entries.body: Whenever this model becomes the target of a Melee Attack, the attacker must pass a Willpower roll or the attack automatically fails.

entries.title: Chlorokinesis
entries.body: This model can be removed from one point inside of a Plant’s action zone, and placed at another point in the same action zone.

entries.title: Claws
entries.body: This model’s Unarmed attacks inflict Damage [[A]] [[B]] .

entries.title: Clay Body
entries.body: This model automatically gains the Charge trait. In addition, this model is immune to the Steal effect and gains -1 to its Endurance rolls. All ranged attacks against this model convert Injury markers [[A]] to Stun markers [[B]] , unless the attack had the Cold or Freeze effects. Conversely, when this model is targeted with an attack with the Electric special rule or Discharge effect, all Stun markers [[B]] are converted to Injury markers [[A]] . In addition, at the start of each of this model’s activations, it may exchange its attached Upgrade card for a different one.

entries.title: Climbing Claws
entries.body: This model never suffers Impaired Movement when Climbing. In addition, the model may end its movement at any point on a climbable surface, such as on the side of a wall. Make the model’s end position clear to the opposing player if it is not possible to physically place the model there.

entries.title: Cloak of Bats
entries.body: Enemy models can only see this model if it is in contact with them. This ability works even when the model is within the area of effect of a Light. However, the model is still subject to other rules that aid detection, such as Total Vision or Night Vision, etc. This model can be affected by templates, but cannot be targeted directly. Also, when an enemy model enters contact with this model, or this model enters contact with an enemy model, that model must take a Willpower roll: if the roll is failed, the model suffers the Scared effect.

entries.title: Close Combat Master
entries.body: When fighting Unarmed, this model may reroll failed attack dice in Melee.

entries.title: Combat Flip
entries.body: This ability may be used when the model is in contact with an enemy. Move this model up to 3”.

entries.title: Combo: (Weapon)
entries.body: For every two successful hits in its attack roll while using the specified weapon or trait (before the enemy rolls to defend), this model gains an additional hit.

entries.title: Commissioner
entries.body: Friendly models with the Arrest trait within 6” of this model can use that trait as an extra action.

entries.title: Concealment
entries.body: Until the end of the round in which this ability is used, enemy models can only see this model if it is in contact with them. This ability works even when the model is within the area of effect of a Light. However, the model is still subject to other rules that aid detection, such as Total Vision or Superior Sense of Smell, etc. This model can be affected by templates, but cannot be targeted directly.

entries.title: Confusion
entries.body: Target an enemy model (not a Vehicle) within 8” and line of sight. Perform an opposed Willpower roll against the target. If successful, reduce the target model’s Attack and Defense skills by 1. Also, the target cannot perform Special Actions. Both effects last until the end of the round.

entries.title: Contractor
entries.body: This model may treat its rank as, but if it does so its Affiliation changes to. In addition, if this model is recruited as the Boss, all models in the crew with the Veteran trait also gain Assassin 2.

entries.title: Control Pheromones
entries.body: Choose an enemy model (not a Vehicle) within 5” and line of sight. The target immediately suffers the Hypnotize effect.

entries.title: Cool Under Fire
entries.body: A crew that includes this model gains +1 Resource Point each round. Also, when a friendly model with the Veteran trait (not Bane himself) activates within 8”, remove one Effect from that model.

entries.title: Competitive
entries.body: This model gains +1 to Attack, Defense and Willpower while there is at least one other friendly model in play with this trait.

entries.title: Computer Intrusion
entries.body: This model may choose up to 2 Suspect markers within 8” and move them up to 2”.

entries.title: Cop
entries.body: Keyword.

entries.title: Corrupt
entries.body: If this model is included your crew, you can recruit up to 3 Henchmen with the Cop trait. Additional models in the crew with this trait have no further effect.

entries.title: Counter Attack
entries.body: When targeted by a Melee Attack, this model can make an Effort to activate this trait. For the remainder of the activation, when this model successfully defends against an enemy Melee Attack, this model gains one Counter Attack for every attack blocked. Once the enemy attack is resolved, assuming this model is not KO or a Casualty, each Counter Attack is converted into an automatic hit against the attacker, calculated as per this model’s preferred Melee Weapon. These Counter Attacks are resolved immediately, out of sequence. After resolving the Counter Attacks, play resumes as normal.

entries.title: Countermeasures
entries.body: This model gains one of the following bonuses at the start of each activation, until its next activation: gain the Stealth trait; gain the Night Vision trait; or ignore the Anti-tank rule.

entries.title: Cooperative Fighting
entries.body: When targeting an enemy with a Melee Attack that is already in contact with another friendly model, this model inflicts 1 additional [[B]] for each hit that inflicts damage.

entries.title: Court of Owls Crew
entries.body: This crew can only hire models with the Affiliation:.

entries.title: Coward’s Reward
entries.body: If this model it not KO when an enemy model moves out of contact from this model, that enemy suffers [[A]] .

entries.title: Criminal
entries.body: Keyword.

entries.title: Criminology
entries.body: All enemy models within 12” of this model lose the benefit of the Runaway trait.

entries.title: Critical Strike
entries.body: After activating this trait, any Melee Attacks performed by this model automatically treat the Strength die as scoring a natural 6. No die is rolled, but the success is counted.

entries.title: Cruel
entries.body: Choose a KO enemy (not a Vehicle) in contact. That model is removed from play as a Casualty.

entries.title: Cybernetic
entries.body: This model gains +1 to its Defense rolls, and can reroll Recovery rolls.

entries.title: Cyclops
entries.body: This model’s ranged attacks gain the Imprecise rule when the target is more than 8” away.

entries.title: Daddy’s Girrrl
entries.body: If this model starts its activation within 6” of the Boss, its gains +1 +.

entries.title: Deadliest Man on Earth
entries.body: The target of this model’s attacks cannot be changed (for example, by use of the Bodyguard trait).

entries.title: Deadly Strike
entries.body: Once this trait is activated, this model gains CRT: Casualty on its Melee Attack Actions for the rest of the round.

entries.title: Dealer
entries.body: During the Recount phase, if the opponent scores an Objective, you may take an Objective from behind your Plot card, and score it immediately, ignoring the usual rules.

entries.title: Death Marks
entries.body: When this model inflicts a Casualty, it gains +2 or +2 or. + + 4

entries.title: Death or Exile
entries.body: Target one KO model (not a Vehicle) within 8” and line of sight. The target model is removed as a Casualty.

entries.title: Death Pack
entries.body: If the target of this model’s Melee Attack is already in contact with one or more other friendly models with this trait, this model gains a +1 bonus to its attack dice rolls, and one extra attack die against that target.

entries.title: Defensive Stance
entries.body: This model ignores the penalties for being Outnumbered in combat, and chooses the direction when it is Pushed.

entries.title: Delirium
entries.body: In the Recount phase, this model does not recover [[B]] Damage, and cannot take rolls to Recover from KO.

entries.title: Demon
entries.body: Enemy models roll 1 less attack die when targeting this model. In addition, this model never reduces its Effort Limit for accumulated Damage.

entries.title: Demon Curse
entries.body: At the beginning of the Take the Lead phase, if there are no models in contact, roll 2D6 for this model and add the results together. For each friendly model removed as a Casualty in the game so far, add +2 to the result. On a result of 11+, place a friendly Etrigan model within 4” of this model, then remove this model from play.

entries.title: Demoralize
entries.body: All enemy Henchmen within 6” suffer the Enervating 1 effect.

entries.title: Demotivate
entries.body: Target a model within 8” and line of sight. That model must pass a Willpower roll or immediately suffer the Enervating 2 effect.

entries.title: Desensitized
entries.body: This model doesn’t suffer KO through accumulated [[B]] . Instead, once it has accumulated [[B]] equal to its Willpower, any additional [[B]] Damage automatically becomes [[A]] Damage instead.

entries.title: Detective
entries.body: This model may place or reveal a Suspect marker within 3” and LoS instead of in contact.

entries.title: Detective Mode
entries.body: This model does not suffer the Blind effect and can see through Smoke.

entries.title: Detonate
entries.body: Target a Suspect marker within 8”. Center an Explosive template on that marker. Roll a Strength 3+ die against each model affected. On a success, the model suffers [[A]] [[B]] . Remove the Suspect marker.

entries.title: Devastating Blow
entries.body: Once this trait is activated, this model gains a +1 Strength die roll bonus and Bleed 1 on its Melee Attack Actions until the end of the round.

entries.title: Dimensional Portal
entries.body: Remove this model and place it up to 12” away. At a cost of a Movement Action (If it has one left to spend), this model may choose one friendly model within 2” before it is removed – the target model is also removed, and placed in contact with this model in its new position. After being placed, this model ends its activation. Any model that was placed with it counts as having moved during its activation, and its Basic Move Distance is 0 for the rest of the round. A model cannot use this trait in two consecutive activations.

entries.title: Direct Connection to the Speed Force
entries.body: This model may reroll the Paradox roll.

entries.title: Dirty Fighter
entries.body: This model can perform Ranged Attacks even if it is in contact with enemy models. If it uses a ranged weapon to target an enemy model in contact, it gains +1 to its attack dice rolls.

entries.title: Dirty Money
entries.body: If this model is the Boss, its crew has an extra $300 Funding.

entries.title: Disappearing
entries.body: Once per round, when this model becomes the target of an enemy attack, this model can move up to 4” before the attack is performed. If this means the enemy could no longer target this model, it can choose a different target.

entries.title: Disarray
entries.body: Target an enemy model within 8” and Line of Sight. If that model has an Audacity marker, you can move the marker to another enemy model within 8” that has yet to activate, and does not already have an Audacity marker.

entries.title: Discharge
entries.body: After activating this ability, the next ranged attack this model performs this round inflicts 1 additional [[A]] damage per hit and costs 1 additional Ammo.

entries.title: Discourage
entries.body: Choose an enemy model (not a Vehicle) within 8” and line of sight. Perform an opposed Willpower roll against the target. If successful, the target model suffers -2 to its Willpower value when performing a Willpower roll until the end of the round.

entries.title: Disguised Sneak Attack
entries.body: Target a model within 2”. Perform an opposed Willpower roll against the target. If successful, the target cannot take Defense rolls or make Efforts against this model’s Attacks until the end of the round.

entries.title: Disruptor
entries.body: Target one enemy model within 8” and line of sight. The target cannot use ranged weapons with the Firearm or Beam rule this round.

entries.title: Distort Magic
entries.body: Make an Effort to active this trait. When the trait is activated, choose any point on the tabletop within 4” of this model. Until the end of the round, this model can cast spells as though it was located at that point.

entries.title: Distract
entries.body: Target one enemy model within 4” and line of sight. The target reduces its Defense skill by -1 until the end of the round. If multiple models with this trait target the same model, the effect is not cumulative.

entries.title: Disturb
entries.body: Target an enemy model within 8” and line of sight that is yet to activate this round. Make an opposed Willpower roll against that model. If successful, you may look at the opponent’s Objective card hand, and Discard one of the cards.

entries.title: Divination
entries.body: This model can use Divination Spells. In addition, once per game the model can reroll one die – you don’t need to accept the second result, and instead may choose between both.

entries.title: Divine Magic
entries.body: This model can use Divine Magic Spells. In addition, once per game this model can spend 1 Magic Point (MP) during its activation to remove 1 Damage marker from its Character Card.

entries.title: Dodge
entries.body: This model can use the Dodging rule.

entries.title: Dollotrons
entries.body: When you recruit Professor Pyg, you must also recruit three Dollotron models, at no additional Reputation cost.

entries.title: Drag
entries.body: If this model passes within 2” of one or more friendly models during a Movement Action, it may make an Effort and target one of those models and place it in base contact at the end of the move. The chosen model cannot have the Large or Huge traits. The target model suffers Impaired Movement during its next activation. This model cannot use the Drag trait in two consecutive activations.

entries.title: Drop a Riddle
entries.body: If you have played during this round at least 2 Objective cards as Resources, place a Suspect or a Riddle marker within 4” of this model.

entries.title: Duelist
entries.body: While in contact with only one enemy model, this model may reroll failed attack dice rolls in Melee.

entries.title: Duke of Duality
entries.body: When this model scores an Objective card, flip a coin or roll a D6: if the result is ‘heads’ (or an even number) draw an additional card. If the result is ‘tails’ (or an odd number), Discard an Objective card at random before drawing a new card.

entries.title: Echolocation
entries.body: This model does not suffer the Blind effect and can see through Smoke. In addition, this model may see at any distance, limited only by line of sight and intervening scenery.

entries.title: ECM
entries.body: All Light sources within 6” of this model are nullified (effectively illuminating an area of 0”).

entries.title: Ectokinesis
entries.body: This model can use Ectokinesis Spells. In addition, once per game this model can spend 1 MP during its activation to reroll its Attack and Strength dice rolls against models with the Incorporeal trait.

entries.title: Electric Handshake
entries.body: Choose a model in contact. The target model must pass a Willpower roll or suffer the Stunned effect.

entries.title: Electric Storm
entries.body: Center the Explosive template on this model. Roll a Strength 3+ die against all models affected by the template (except the attacking model itself) with Damage [[B]] [[B]] .

entries.title: Eldritch
entries.body: This model can use Eldritch Spells. In addition, once per game during its activation, the model gains +1 to its Attacks value until the end of the round.

entries.title: Elite: X
entries.body: Your crew can only include 1 Elite model of each type, unless you also include the Elite Boss: Type.

entries.title: Elite Boss: X
entries.body: If your crew includes a model with this trait, you may include any number of Elite models of the same type as the Elite Boss (following the normal restrictions for forming a crew).

entries.title: Elusive
entries.body: When targeted by a Ranged Attack, this model may make an Effort to force the attacker to reroll one attack die.

entries.title: EMP
entries.body: This model rerolls failed Strength die rolls against models with the Cybernetic, Bot or Robot traits, and against models with the Vehicle rank.

entries.title: Enemies of the Court
entries.body: While this model is in play, if any of your models removes an enemy as a Casualty, you may pick one Objective card from the Spent Resources pile and add it to your hand.

entries.title: Energy Field
entries.body: Roll 1D6 for each hit this model suffers from a Ranged Attack. On a result of 5+, the hit is ignored.

entries.title: Enhanced Vision
entries.body: This model can see at any distance and ignores the Concealment trait. In addition, the model is immune to the Blind effect.

entries.title: Escape Artist
entries.body: After resolving an enemy attack against this model, as long as it is not made KO or a Casualty, it may immediately move up to 4”.

entries.title: Evidence Tampering
entries.body: When this model Reveals an enemy Suspect marker, it may place a friendly Suspect marker in contact with it first. Then, remove the enemy Suspect marker as normal.

entries.title: Exhaustive Planner
entries.body: One use only. When the opponent plays an Objective card as a Resource, this model can cancel that card’s effect. The opponent must immediately Discard the card.

entries.title: Exorcism
entries.body: This model can use Exorcism Spells. In addition, once per game during its activation but before casting any Spell, this model can spend 1 MP to add +1 to the result of all Magical tests until the end of the round.

entries.title: Expendable
entries.body: When this model is removed from the game as a Casualty, you may draw an Objective card.

entries.title: Experimental Ammo
entries.body: This model can’t Manipulate Ammo Crates.

entries.title: Expert Marksman
entries.body: This model gains a +1 bonus to its attack dice rolls when performing Ranged Attacks. Note: This trait is also called Ranged Master on some character cards.

entries.title: Exploit the Weakness
entries.body: When a friendly model with the Assassin trait within 8” of this model makes an attack, the target reduces its Effort limit by -1 for the duration of that action.

entries.title: Explosive Gel
entries.body: Once per activation, this model may mark a Streetlamp, Sewer or Suspect marker in contact as being sprayed with Explosive Gel (use a spare token or dice to remind you). In any subsequent activation, this model may use a Manipulate action to destroy any number of marked items. Center an Explosive template on each chosen marker, and roll a Strength 3+ die against each affected model. Any model hit suffers [[B]] [[B]] Damage. Then, remove that marked items from the game

entries.title: Extended Limbs
entries.body: This model can perform Melee Attacks against models up to 3” away as if they were in contact.

entries.title: Extremely Mutated
entries.body: This model cannot buy more than one item of Equipment.

entries.title: Fast
entries.body: This model gains +2” to its basic move distance.

entries.title: Feint
entries.body: Target a single enemy model in contact with this model and take a Willpower roll. If the roll is successful, the target can’t make an Effort against this model’s attacks this round.

entries.title: Feral (SPECIAL)
entries.body: Once this trait is activated, this model’s Melee Attacks this round gain a +1 bonus to attack dice rolls, and gain the Pinned Down effect.

entries.title: Ferocious
entries.body: This model’s Melee Attacks gain the Push effect.

entries.title: Fire Immunity
entries.body: This model cannot be affected by the Fire effect.

entries.title: Flak Armor
entries.body: This model is immune to Damage caused by hits with the Explosive and/or Expansive rules.

entries.title: Flaming Wave
entries.body: Center the Explosive template on this model. Roll a Strength 3+ die against all models affected by the template (except the attacking model itself) with Damage [[A]] and the Fire effect. After the use of this trait is resolved, this model receives [[B]] Damage.

entries.title: Flare
entries.body: One use only. Make the entire gaming area count as being under the effect of Light until the end of round.

entries.title: Fly
entries.body: Once per round, this model may add +8” to its basic move distance, and can move in any direction (including vertically). When using this ability, the model can move over obstacles and Difficult Ground without extra cost or penalty.

entries.title: Flying High
entries.body: One use only. This model may add +20” to its basic move distance, and can move in any direction (including vertically). When using this ability, the model can move over obstacles and Difficult Ground without extra cost or penalty.

entries.title: Follow Me!
entries.body: Choose a friendly Henchman within 4” of this model (but not the activated model itself). That model gains a +4” marker. +4

entries.title: Football Gear
entries.body: Enemies attacking this model never benefit from the Sharp and Heavy weapon special rules.

entries.title: For the Family
entries.body: If a friendly Carmine Falcone within 4” and LoS of this model suffers any number of hits from an Attack (of any kind), this model may make an Effort to take the hits instead and all the effects of that attack. Only one Effort [[B]] is required per enemy Attack. This trait can’t be used against attacks from a model with Name: Selina Kyle.

entries.title: Force Field
entries.body:
Target friendly model in contact benefits from Cover until the end of the round, even if it is not behind Cover.
Fully Equipped: This model can purchase any equipment listed for Jason Todd even if it comes from a different crew’s equipment list.

entries.title: Funny Bomb
entries.body: Center the Explosive template over this model. This is resolved as an Explosive Ranged Attack, rolling a Strength 3+ die for each affected model – on a successful roll, the model receives [[A]] [[B]] Damage. Once this action is resolved, remove this model as a Casualty.

entries.title: Gas Jumper
entries.body: This model adds +6” to its basic move distance, and can move in any direction (including vertically). The model can move over obstacles and Difficult Ground without penalty. All models within 4” and Los of this model at the end of the Movement action suffer Poison and Enervating 1, with the Gas effect. When this trait is activated, this model may perform Melee Attacks against models within 3” instead of only in contact, until the end of the round.

entries.title: Gas Mask
entries.body: This model ignores Damage and effects caused by any Attack or trait with the Gas special rule.

entries.title: Genius
entries.body: Once per round, this model can remove an Audacity marker from one friendly model, and give it to another friendly model that is yet to activate.

entries.title: Get ’Em
entries.body: One friendly model within 8” and line of sight of this model gains +2 +.

entries.title: Ghost
entries.body: This model has the Invulnerability 1 and Incorporeal traits. Its Incorporeal trait is always active, and never has to be activated by spending an Action.

entries.title: Goad
entries.body: Target one enemy model (not a Vehicle) within 8” and line of sight, and take an opposed Willpower roll against it. If you succeed, you may move the enemy model up to 4”, following all of the usual Movement rules. During this movement, you cannot force the target to Fall.

entries.title: Good Aim
entries.body: This model can move and fire (or fire and move) when using a weapon with the Aim weapon special rule. In addition, the model gains +1 to its attack dice rolls with Ranged Attacks until the end of the round.

entries.title: Gotham City Siren
entries.body: One use only. Target another friendly model with this trait within 4” – the target gains +2 + or.

entries.title: Grand Strategist
entries.body: While this model is in play and not KO, you gain +2 Resource points.

entries.title: Grapple Gun
entries.body: See Batclaw.

entries.title: Greed
entries.body: This model cannot contribute to or fulfil criteria for Objective cards that award VP for inflicting Damage, making models KO, or removing models as Casualties.

entries.title: Green Magic
entries.body: This model can use Green Spells. In addition, once per game this model can spend 1 MP to remove 2 Damage markers from its character card.

entries.title: Green Travel
entries.body: One use only. Remove this model and immediately place it up to 20” away. A model may not perform a Movement Action in the same round that it uses Green Travel.

entries.title: Green Web
entries.body: Target friendly model with the Plant trait within 8” of this model immediately performs an Attack action.

entries.title: Grin Twins
entries.body: This model gains +1 to Attack, Defense and Willpower while there is at least one other friendly model in play with this trait.

entries.title: Gunman
entries.body: After activating this trait, if this model performs a Ranged Attack, it gains an extra Ranged Attack action.

entries.title: Hacking
entries.body: This model may move up to 2 markers within 8” up to 4”.

entries.title: Hallucination
entries.body: This model can use this trait to place a friendly model (not KO or Knocked Down) with Alias: Bat-Mite in contact with itself.

entries.title: Handyman
entries.body: This model can make an extra Manipulate action during its activation. Also, this model can use a Manipulate action in contact with a model with the Vehicle rank to remove up to 2 Damage markers from it.

entries.title: Hard Guys
entries.body: If this model is your Boss, friendly Henchmen that attack with Brass Knuckles or Reinforced Gloves may re-roll failed Strength die rolls.

entries.title: Hardened
entries.body: Once per round, when this model suffers Damage, it can choose to change the Damage type of up to 1 Damage marker received.

entries.title: Hates: Crew/s
entries.body: This model can never be Included in the specified crew/s.

entries.title: Hates Humanity
entries.body: This model cannot be affected by friendly models’ traits.

entries.title: Hazard Armor
entries.body: This model ignores the Poison, Toxic and Fire effects. In addition, enemies roll 1 less attack die when targeting this model.

entries.title: Heavy Armor
entries.body: Enemy models roll 3 less attack dice when targeting this model.

entries.title: Heir to the Cowl
entries.body: When forming your crew, if there is no model with the Alias: Batman (any version) in the same crew, this model changes its rank to.

entries.title: Henchman Bomb
entries.body: One use only. This model may choose one friendly Henchman model and center an Explosive template on it. This is resolved as an Explosive Ranged Attack, rolling a Strength 2+ die for each affected model, and inflicting Damage [[A]] [[A]] [[A]] on a successful roll. After resolving this attack, the chosen Henchman is removed as a casualty.

entries.title: Heroic
entries.body: Target any one friendly model on the board. That model can perform 1 extra Action this round.

entries.title: Hidden
entries.body: After both groups of both crews are deployed, this model may be deployed anywhere on the gaming area. If both sides have Hidden models, start with the player with setup initiative. This model must be placed out of line of sight of all enemy models if possible, or at least 12” away from enemy models that can see it. If this is not possible, this model must be deployed in the usual deployment zone.

entries.title: Hidden Boss
entries.body: When its crew’s Boss becomes a Casualty, this model immediately becomes the new Boss, taking the marker. Increase this model’s Willpower by +1 for the rest of the game. In addition, this model does not halve the range of the Inspire trait when taking over as Boss. If more than one model in the crew has this trait, or another trait with the same effect (such as Chain of Command) the controlling player must choose between them.

entries.title: Hidden Plans
entries.body: Unless a friendly Boss is within 8” of this model (or this model is the Boss), friendly models does not inflict additional damage for attacking K. O. models. If this model is the Boss, when you score an Objective card other than for making enemies models KO or Casualty, you gain 1 Resource point.

entries.title: Hidden Sniper
entries.body: Select a target that this model can see, and that is also within 12” of any board edge. The target receives a Ranged Attack, ignoring Cover. This attack has RoF 1, Damage [[A]] [[A]] , and the Firearm rule.

entries.title: Hockey Gear
entries.body: Enemies attacking this model never benefit from the Sharp weapon special rule.

entries.title: Hold Breath
entries.body: When performing a Ranged Attack, this model may spend any markers it has to gain a +1 bonus to the attack dice rolls, and increase the natural score required for a Critical Hit on the Strength die by 1 for each marker spent (so, if the model spends 2 markers, it gains +2 to hit and scores a CRT on a 4+ instead of a 6). In addition, in any activation in which this model does not perform a Movement and Attack action, it may immediately gain up to 3 markers, but suffers the Enervating X effect (where X is equal to the number of markers it gains).

entries.title: Homo Magi
entries.body: This model counts its Willpower value as 1 point higher when taking Magical tests.

entries.title: Hover
entries.body: At the start of this model’s activation, you may place a Hover marker on the character card until the end of the round, to show that it is in Hover mode. While a model is in Hover mode, it can only be hit in Melee on a natural result of 6. A model with a Hover marker cannot benefit from the Cover rule and cannot perform the Manipulate action.

entries.title: Huge
entries.body: This model ignores up to 2 [[B]] Damage per enemy Attack.

entries.title: I Believe in Harvey Dent
entries.body: If this model is the Boss, friendly Henchmen must roll a die or flip a coin at the start of their activation. If the result is even/heads, that model gains 1 free Effort until the end of the round. If the result is odd/tails, it suffers Enervating 1.

entries.title: I Know What I’m Doing
entries.body: One use only. This model can ignore the result on the Paradox table. The Speed Power still fails.

entries.title: I’m Batman
entries.body: After all other models have deployed, this model deploys anywhere on the gaming area. When it deploys, all models within 2” must pass an Endurance roll or become Knocked Down. In addition, once per game, this model may reroll a Strength die.

entries.title: Iceberg Lounge
entries.body: If this model is your Boss, one of your Henchmen may purchase a single Equipment option at double Funding cost from another crew list when configuring the crew. This does not include Equipment that requires the inclusion of a specific model to purchase.

entries.title: Ice Flash
entries.body: Select a target model within 10” and line of sight. The target must pass an Endurance roll, or become subject to the Cooled effect. If the target passes the Endurance roll, it still suffers -1 to its Defense skill until the end of the round, and the Slow 2 effect.

entries.title: Immortal
entries.body: Removing this model as a Casualty cannot fulfil the requirements of an opponent’s Objective card.

entries.title: Impetuous
entries.body: If this model Attacks the model that was closest to it when it activated, it gains 2 additional attack dice, but suffers -1 to its Defense skill until the end of the round. If two or more enemy models are equally closest, attacking either of them will trigger this trait.

entries.title: Incorporeal
entries.body: This model is immune to [[B]] Damage until the end of the round. In addition, the model can move ‘through’ other models and scenery as though they weren’t there, but still cannot end its move overlapping another model or inside solid scenery.

entries.title: Informer
entries.body: As long as this model is not KO, the crew gains one additional Pass on Activation.

entries.title: Inspire
entries.body: All friendly Henchmen that start their activation within 8” of this model gain 1 extra Manipulate action.

entries.title: Inspire Fear
entries.body:
Target an enemy model (not a Vehicle) within 4” and line of sight. The target must take a Willpower roll. If this roll is failed, consult the following chart:
Fails by 1-2: Target suffers the Scared effect.
Fails by 3-5: Target suffers the Scared, Terror 1 and Slow 2 effects.
Fails by 6 or more: Target is removed as a casualty.

entries.title: Instinctive Shooting
entries.body: In the round in which this trait is activated, this model’s ranged weapons don’t lose dice for moving before attacking.

entries.title: Intel Support
entries.body: This model cannot be the target of an attack, and does not suffer effects or damage inflicted by traits. When an enemy model removes 1 of your Suspects, this model takes 1 [[A]] damage. When this model would be removed as a Casualty, remove all the damage from its character card and remove the model from the gaming area. In any subsequent Raise the Plan phase, you may reduce your Audacity markers by 1 during that round to return this model to play, placing it anywhere on the gaming area.

entries.title: Interrogation
entries.body: When this model scores at least 2 hits with a Melee Attack, this model or another friendly model in play, may immediately make an extra move of 4” or place a Suspect marker.

entries.title: Intimidate
entries.body: Target an enemy model (not a Vehicle) within 8” and line of sight. For the rest of the round, the target cannot perform Special Actions and loses a die when performing Willpower rolls.

entries.title: Intimidation
entries.body: Target an enemy model (not a Vehicle) within 8” and line of sight. The target must pass a Willpower roll or be unable to perform Melee Attacks this round.

entries.title: Invaluable
entries.body: When this model becomes a Casualty, the opponent gains 1 Resource point.

entries.title: Invulnerability (X)
entries.body: This model is immune to the CRT: Casualty effect. In addition, the first ‘X’ Damage markers received by this model during each round are ignored.

entries.title: It’s Mine
entries.body: Enemy models cannot Reveal your Suspect markers while the marker is within 2” of this model.

entries.title: I Will Break You
entries.body:
When you recruit this model, choose one of the following options:
• Bane gains +3 Extra Venom Doses and may apply them to a friendly model within 4” during his activation.
• Bane gains Exhaustive Planner and +1 Willpower.
• Bane Gains Close Combat Master.

entries.title: Joker’s Gas
entries.body: All other models within 4” and LoS suffer Enervating 1 and the Poison effect, with the Gas rule.

entries.title: Joy for the Victory
entries.body: Friendly models within 8” gain +1 to their Willpower value while performing Willpower rolls. In addition, friendly models within 8” that score an Objective card during their activation may immediately move up to 2”.

entries.title: Judgment
entries.body: When this model makes an enemy model KO, flip a coin or roll a D6: if the result is ‘heads’ (or an even number) remove the enemy model as a Casualty.

entries.title: Juggernaut
entries.body: When this model completes a Movement action you may Push all models in contact 2” (no hits are required). In addition, this model gains +1 to its attack dice rolls against models contacted in this way this round.

entries.title: Jump Up
entries.body: Whenever this model would suffer the Knocked Down effect, it may first immediately make an Effort to remove the effect.

entries.title: Kaos Agent
entries.body: All Henchmen in this model’s crew gain the Trickster trait for the duration of the game. You do not have to place all of your Audacity Activation markers during the Raise the Plan phase (or any, if you wish). Instead, whenever a friendly model with the Trickster trait activates, you may give it one of your remaining Audacity Activation markers.

entries.title: KaPow!!!
entries.body: Until the end of its activation this model’s Melee Attacks gain +1 to attack dice rolls and Blunt 3.

entries.title: Kevlar Vest
entries.body: Whenever this model takes Damage from an enemy attack or special rule, reduce the total number of Damage markers it receives by 1, to a minimum of 1. You may choose which marker is ignored.

entries.title: Kill them!
entries.body: Target a friendly Henchmen within 4” of this model (but not the activated model itself). Target model gains +2 +.

entries.title: Kite
entries.body: While performing a Move action, this model increases the maximum distance it can move by 2” for each Suspect within 4” (measured once at any point during the Move). In addition, this model can move in any direction (including vertically) over obstacles and Difficult Ground without extra cost or penalty.

entries.title: Kobra Armor
entries.body: Once per round, this model may make 1 Effort to gain 1 marker.

entries.title: Kryptonian (X)
entries.body:
A model with this trait gains a number of rules determined by the trait’s level (X), see below.
1: Fast, Invulnerability/1, Natural Immunities.
2: Fast, Invulnerability/2, Natural Immunities, Super Jump.
3: Fast, Fly, Invulnerability/3, Natural Immunities.
4: Fast, Fly, Invulnerability/3, Natural Immunities, Tough Skin.
5: Fast, Fly, Hover, Flying High, Invulnerability/4, Natural Immunities, Tough Skin.
6: Fast, Fly, Hover, Flying High, Invulnerability/5, Natural Immunities, Tough Skin.
If the game is affected by the Day rules, the Invulnerability rule is improved by +1 and all the levels gain the Regeneration trait.

entries.title: Kryptonite
entries.body: While a model with this trait is within 4” of a model with the Kryptonian trait, the Kryptonian model loses the Invulnerability and Regeneration traits (if they possess them).

entries.title: Lantern
entries.body: A model with this trait can activate it at any time during its activation. The model counts as a Light source with a radius of 2” until the end of the round.

entries.title: Large
entries.body: This model ignores up to 1 [[B]] Damage per attack suffered.

entries.title: Laser Sight
entries.body: Target one model in line of sight. The target counts as being under the effect of Lights until the end of the round, or until the target moves or changes its current position.

entries.title: Lasso of Persuasion
entries.body: One use only. Target an enemy model within 2”. That model suffers the Hypnotize effect.

entries.title: Leadership
entries.body: All friendly models within 8” of this model may reroll Willpower rolls.

entries.title: Lethal Blow
entries.body: Once this trait is activated, for the rest of the round when this model damages a non-vehicle enemy with a Melee Attack Action, the damaged model suffers the Stunned effect too.

entries.title: Let’s Ride
entries.body: Once per round, choose another model within 6” and line of sight. If the target is a friendly model, it gains two + or markers. If the target model is an enemy, it immediately suffers the Enervating 2 effect.

entries.title: Light Armor
entries.body: Enemy models roll 1 less attack dice when targeting this model.

entries.title: Living Legend
entries.body: This model can be activated twice each round. Each activation is independent of the other (and cannot be made consecutively unless there is no other choice). If the model has an Audacity marker, it is only used for one of its activations. In addition, once per round, when a trait specifies this model as a target, you may cancel the use of that trait. A crew that includes a Living Legend loses one Pass on Activation each round (if applicable).

entries.title: Long Guns
entries.body: If this model is the Boss, then at the start of the first Raise the Plan phase you may select up to three friendly Henchmen with ranged weapons with the Short Range and Firearm rules. Those weapons replace the Short Range rule with the Medium Range rule for the duration of the game.

entries.title: Lord of Business
entries.body: If this model is the Boss, its crew has an extra $500 in its Funding stash. In addition, when a friendly model plays the Valuable Commodities card, you may place an additional Loot marker in contact with another Suspect marker.

entries.title: Lord of the Sewers
entries.body: This model may deploy in contact with any Sewer marker. In addition, this model’s crew generates 1 extra Sewer marker. Once per game, this model can exit from a sewer and continue moving.

entries.title: Luck
entries.body: Once per round, this model may reroll any single die that it has rolled, for whatever reason.

entries.title: Lunatic Laugh
entries.body: All other models (not Vehicles) within 4” of this model lose 1 Defense die during their next roll.

entries.title: Magical Power X
entries.body: All models with this trait can use Elemental Spells. The value ‘X’ is the number of Magic Points (MP) the model can spend during a round. Each spell costs a number of MPs to cast. At the Beginning of the Raise the Plan phase, the model gains a number of MPs equal to X. At the end Recovery phase, all unspent MPs are lost.

entries.title: Magic Tattoos
entries.body: This model is immune to the Steal and Fire effects.

entries.title: Make them Perfect
entries.body: This model’s Attack actions gain the Push effect, but the direction of the Push must be directly towards a friendly Professor Pyg model if he is in play.

entries.title: Manipulative
entries.body: When this model is in your Crew, you may redeploy up to two friendly models after normal deployment but before the game starts. In addition, at the end of each Raise the Plan phase you may nominate one model to take a Willpower roll. If this roll fails, the target model must be the last model in its crew to be activated that round.

entries.title: Martial Artist
entries.body: This model ignores the penalty for being Outnumbered in combat.

entries.title: Martial Expert
entries.body: This model causes a Critical on a Strength die natural result of 4, 5, or 6, not just 6.

entries.title: Master Criminal
entries.body: All friendly Henchmen with the Criminal trait benefit from a +1 bonus to their attack dice rolls when making Attacks.

entries.title: Master Fighter
entries.body: This model gains a +1 bonus to its attack dice rolls when performing Unarmed Melee Attacks.

entries.title: Master Marksman
entries.body: This model can reroll failed attack dice rolls when performing Ranged Attacks.

entries.title: Master of Stealth
entries.body: When this model is under the effect of the Night rule, it can only be seen by enemies within 6” instead of the usual range. It is still subject to rules that aid detection, such as Lights, Total Vision, etc. When this model benefits from the Sneak Attack trait, it gains +1 to its attack dice rolls.

entries.title: Mastermind
entries.body: If this model is in play and not KO, its controlling player gains +1 to the Take the Lead roll.

entries.title: Mechanical Mount
entries.body: This model gains +4” to its basic move distance, but can neither Jump nor Climb.

entries.title: Medic
entries.body: This model may remove up to 2 damage markers from a friendly model in contact (not Vehicle) with at least 1 Damage marker of any kind. If this ability is used to recover a model that is yet to activate that round from KO, the opponent gains a Pass marker.

entries.title: Meditation X
entries.body: At the start of this model’s activation it may make up to X Efforts. The model gains X Magic Points until the end of the round. These points can exceed the maximum that a model can generate and spend as detailed by the Magical Power trait.

entries.title: Medium Armor
entries.body: Enemy models roll 2 less attack dice when targeting this model.

entries.title: Meet Goliath!
entries.body: This model can only be recruited in a crew or Team containing a model with Name: Damian Wayne. However, this model can never be recruited to a crew. This model does not reduce its Effort Limit due to accumulated Damage and it may make 2 free Efforts when performing an Attack, and when Defending.

entries.title: Menace
entries.body: Enemy models must spend one additional Action (of its choice) to choose this model as the target of an Attack. This effect lasts until the end of the round.

entries.title: Mental Dominance
entries.body: Once per round, this model may target an enemy model within 4” and line of sight. That model must take a Willpower roll. If it fails, you can perform one Action with that model, out of sequence, temporarily treating it as though it was one of your own models. You may not perform any action that could cause Damage to the target model (such as Falling, or deliberately positioning an Explosive template so it is affected, etc).

entries.title: Mentoring
entries.body: This model can only purchase one piece of Equipment. If its crew or Team list contains a Leader or Sidekick with Affiliation: Brave and the Bold, all [[A]] Damage inflicted by this model is automatically converted to [[B]] Damage. In addition, this model gains the Boy Wonder and True Love: Bruce Wayne traits, and any model with Name: Bruce Wayne in the same crew or Team gains True Love: Damian Wayne until the end of the game.

entries.title: Mercenary
entries.body: You can only recruit this model in a League of Assassins crew if a model with Name: Bane is also included in the crew.

entries.title: Military Teamwork
entries.body: A friendly model performing an Attack against an enemy in contact with this model gains +1 to its Attacks skill for the duration of the Attack.

entries.title: Military Tradition
entries.body: Other friendly models with the Veteran trait within 8” can move up to 2” immediately.

entries.title: Millionaire
entries.body: This model’s crew gains an additional $400 Funding.

entries.title: Mind Blast
entries.body: Target a model (not a Vehicle) within 8” and line of sight. The target must pass a Willpower roll or receive [[A]] [[A]] damage.

entries.title: Mind Control Device
entries.body: Choose a Suspect marker within 8”. Target a model within 4” of that Suspect marker. That model immediately suffers the Hypnotize effect. Remove that marker.

entries.title: Mind Control Substance
entries.body: When this model is recruited to your crew, friendly models with the Henchman rank cannot have their Willpower value reduced by any means, and during the Recovery phase they recovers automatically from KO.

entries.title: Mind Trick
entries.body: After a model within 8” of this model reveals a Suspect, you may move one Suspect in play up to 4”.

entries.title: Mine
entries.body: Convert a Suspect marker in contact with this model into a Mine marker (is still a Suspect marker). When a model moves within 2” of the Mine marker, immediately roll a Strength 2+ die against it. If the roll is successful, the model suffers [[A]] [[A]] Damage, and the marker is removed from play. If the roll fails, remove the Mine Marker.

entries.title: Minion
entries.body: This model can be hired up to three times in a crew, regardless of its Name.

entries.title: Mixed Combat Style
entries.body: After this model performs an Attack action it can perform an extra Attack action (of a different type from the first) during the same activation.

entries.title: Mob
entries.body: A crew that includes this model may have up to +2 additional Suspect markers in play at any one time.

entries.title: Mobster
entries.body: When attacking an Outnumbered model in close combat, this model rolls an additional attack die.

entries.title: Monitoring Device
entries.body: Until the end of the round, this model gains Total Vision and its ranged weapons gain Remote Controlled.

entries.title: Moral Compass
entries.body: This model cannot attack KO models.

entries.title: Mortal Kiss
entries.body: If this model successfully performs at least 3 hits against a model (not a Vehicle), remove the target model as Casualty.

entries.title: Mud
entries.body: Enemy models in contact with this model that wish to move must spend a Special action as well as a Movement action. In addition, this model’s attacks gain the Slow 4 effect.

entries.title: Multifire
entries.body: When using a ranged weapon, this model gains +2 attack dice. The model cannot move in the same round that it uses this ability.

entries.title: Multitask
entries.body:
This model chooses one of the following options before the game begins:
• Explorer: Gain the Undercover trait and +2 basic move distance.
• Hacker: Gain +1 Willpower. Also gains the Computer Intrusion trait.
• Defender: Gain +2 Endurance. Also gains the Force Field trait.
• Fighter: Gains +1 Attack, +1 Defense and the Claws trait.

entries.title: Multiverse Teleportation Device
entries.body: This model may not be deployed as normal at the start of the game. Instead, at the start of the Raise the Plan phase of the second round, place this model anywhere on the board (but not inside a building or similar enclosed space).

entries.title: My Idol!
entries.body: This model can only be recruited if a model with the Alias: Zur- En-Arrh Batman is part of the crew. In addition, while a friendly model with Alias: Zur-En-Arrh Batman is in play and not KO, this model gains +1 Willpower.

entries.title: Narcotic Dose (DOSE)
entries.body: A model may use a Narcotics Dose at any time during its activation. If it does so, the model gains the Desensitized trait until the end of the round.

entries.title: Natural Immunities
entries.body: This model cannot be affected by the Blind, Poison or Steal effects.

entries.title: Necromancy
entries.body: This model can use Necromancy Spells. In addition, once per game during its activation this model can spend 2 MPs to inflict [[A]] Damage to another model in contact, and then remove 1 Damage marker from itself.

entries.title: Negative Speed Force
entries.body: While this model is in play, the Speed Force Pool maximum is reduced by 2.

entries.title: Night Vision
entries.body: This model ignores the Night rule.

entries.title: No Mercy!!!
entries.body: All friendly Henchmen add the Bleed 1 effect to their Attacks.

entries.title: Non-Lethal Ammo
entries.body: When this model attacks non-Vehicle models with its ranged weapons, all [[A]] damage becomes [[B]] damage.

entries.title: Objectives? Puzzles everywhere!!!
entries.body: A crew that includes this model does not accomplish Objective cards following the normal rules. Instead, when a model that share an Affiliation with this model place a Suspect marker, you must roll 1D3. Place a Number Counter on top of that Suspect marker with an equal value as the roll. At the end of the round, you score Objective cards that shown the same VP value as the Number Counters on top of the friendly Suspect markers. Each Number Counter only accomplish 1 Objective card and then, is removed.

entries.title: Obsessive (Mental Disorder)
entries.body: If this model selects the same target for all of its Attacks in a single activation, it gains +1 to the Strength die roll.

entries.title: Obstinate
entries.body: Once per round, when this model cannot make an Effort because it has reached the Effort Limit, it gains 1 free Effort. Additionally, this model can make Effort once per round when taking a Willpower roll.

entries.title: OCD (Mental Disorder)
entries.body: If this model selects the same target for all of its attacks in a single activation, it gains +1 to its attack dice rolls.

entries.title: Occultism
entries.body: This model can use Occultism Spells. In addition, once per game during its activation, the model gains +1 to its Defense value until the end of the round.

entries.title: Offensive Defense
entries.body: When this model blocks at least 1 hit from a melee attack, then after resolving the action the attacking model suffers [[B]] [[B]] damage and is Pushed 2” (in a direction of your choice).

entries.title: One-Armed
entries.body: This model suffers a -1 penalty to its defense die rolls.

entries.title: One of the Boys
entries.body: This model benefits from the Boss’s Inspire rule exactly as if it held the Henchman rank.

entries.title: One Shot Gun
entries.body: One use only. Choose an enemy model within 8” and line of sight. Roll a Strength 2+ die with Damage [[A]] [[A]] [[A]] , and Bleed 3. This ability is considered a Ranged Attack with the Anti-Tank rule, so all rules, traits and abilities that relate to it are in effect (i. e. Line of Sight, Cover, and traits that affect Ranged Attacks).

entries.title: Order
entries.body: Target another friendly model within line of sight. The chosen model can immediately place a Suspect marker.

entries.title: Outlaw Field Commander
entries.body: Choose another friendly model within 4” and line of sight. That model gains +2 + or.

entries.title: Painful Empathy
entries.body: Transfer up to 2 Damage markers from another friendly model in line of sight (not a Vehicle) to this model. If any Damage markers are moved in this way, this model gains +1 to its Attacks and Defense skills until the end of the round.

entries.title: Panda Costume
entries.body: This model must spend an Action (any type) to stand up. This model may do nothing else during that Action.

entries.title: Paranoid (Mental Disorder)
entries.body: If this model has at least 1 Damage marker on its character card, then during the Raise the Plan phase it gains a marker.

entries.title: Penguin Caller
entries.body: If you have less than 3 friendly Explosive Penguins in play you may place an Explosive Penguin within 2” of this model and in contact with a friendly Suspect marker. Then, remove that friendly Suspect marker. For each model with the Animal trait within 4” of this model, add +1” to the distance at which the Explosive Penguin may be placed. Finally, the opponent gains a Pass marker.

entries.title: Penguin Feeder
entries.body: Once per activation, this model can restore Ammo Magazines used earlier in the game to friendly models with the Animal trait within 4”. Remove 1 friendly Suspect marker within 4” of this model for each magazine restored. In addition, Explosive Penguin models within 4” inflict 1 additional [[A]] when using the Self- Destruct trait. This model’s Inspire trait range is improved by +2”. However, it cannot benefit from the Protective or Small special rules until this Upgrade is disabled.

entries.title: Perfect Creations
entries.body: If a friendly Professor Pyg is removed from the game as a Casualty, all friendly Dollotrons are removed as well. Dollotrons never count towards Objective requirements for being made KO or becoming a Casualty. If a friendly Professor Pyg within 4” of this model and LoS is hit by an Attack (of any kind), this model can make an Effort to take the hit instead, and all the effects of that attack. Dollotrons can only be recruited in a crew that contains Professor Pyg.

entries.title: Performance
entries.body: If this model is in play and not KO, enemy models within 6” that wish to perform an Attack, or use traits, must first take a Willpower roll. If they fail the test they suffer -1 to their attack dice rolls until the end of the round.

entries.title: Personalities
entries.body: At the end of each Take the Lead phase, shuffle all the Personalities cards and draw one at random. Apply the rules on that card to this model until the end of the round. This model cannot use its weapons unless it draws the Personalities card that allows it. In addition, if the opponent has 5 VP more than you, and/or this model has 3 or more Damage markers, you may draw 3 cards and choose one.

entries.title: Persuasive
entries.body: At the end of this model’s activation, nominate any enemy model in line of sight that is yet to activate this round. That model must be the next to activate. The opponent can’t use a Pass to ignore this rule. A model can use this trait once per round.

entries.title: Pickpocket
entries.body: This model may perform a Manipulate action to target a KO model in contact. If it does so, immediately follow the rules for the Steal effect.

entries.title: Planning the Move
entries.body: All other friendly models with the Gotham City Siren rule in this model’s crew gain the Primary Target trait until the end of the game.

entries.title: Plant
entries.body:
Each Plant recruited to your crew grants you one friendly Suspect marker that may be placed anywhere on the board at the end of the Choose Plot Cards step of the pre-game sequence. Plants are not deployed as usual – instead, during a friendly model’s activation, you may place one of your Plants in contact with a friendly Suspect and then remove that Suspect. Always are considered an activable model and inside the gaming area.
• If a Plant gets Knocked Out, immediately remove it as a Casualty.
• A plant may receive an Audacity marker even if it is not in play.
• A Plant’s basic move distance cannot be increased by any means.
• Plants have a 4” ‘action zone’ radius. Within that radius, Plants are able to attack in Melee (no line of sight or contact is needed), and may perform the Manipulate action.
• Plants can only Manipulate to reveal Suspects.
• Plants are immune to the Poison, Knocked Down, Hypnotize and Blind effects.
