entries.title: Showmanship
entries.body: ! During this model's activation you may play a Resource without paying its cost if this model has 2 enemy models within 4.

entries.title: Snow Storm
entries.body: Center the Explosive template on this model. Roll a Strength 3+ die against all other models affected by the template with Damage [[B]] [[B]]. Any Suspects affected become Frozen.

entries.title: Soul-Self (Spell)
entries.body: Movement Action. 1 Magic Counter. Target up to X friendly models or friendly Thwarts within 4" of this model (x is equal to the additional Magic Counters spent to Cast this Spell). This model is placed within 8" and all the targeted models/Thwarts are placed within 4” of the final position of this ‘model. This model ignores up to 2 Damage this round.

entries.title: Spades
entries.body: Keyword. If this model has a friendly Suspect within 4" during an Attack roll, you may replace a drawn card with a card from your hand. That card gains +1 to the result.

entries.title: Stalker
entries.body: When activating a trait that targets an enemy model, this model may treat its position as that of a friendly Suspect within 8.

entries.title: Support (Batman)
entries.body: Target a friendly model with Alias: X within 8" and LoS. Immediately perform an action with that model.

entries.title: Tactical Approach
entries.body: During this model's activation you may discard 1 card from your hand to Move 4" a friendly marker that is within 8" of another friendly model.

entries.title: Tangible Fear
entries.body: Any time a model within 4” of this model receives a hit, or fails a Willpower roll, you may discard 1 card from the top of the friendly objective deck (not cumulative). In addition, while this model attacks, the target's Defense is reduced by 1 if its Willpower is less than 6. While this model is attacked, the Attack value of the attacking model is reduced by 1 if its Willpower is less than 6. In addition, this model cannot remove damage caused by other model's effects unless specified.

entries.title: Terrible Revelation
entries.body: Enemy models within 8" of this model add 1 additional dice and add all the 3 results together while taking a Willpower roll produced by a model with Affiliation: (AFF_CULTS_ICON}. If the enemy models within range Effort to add an additional die to the Willpower roll, then they must roll 4D6 and then choose 3 of them.

entries.title: The Crew
entries.body: All friendly models with this model's Affiliation within 8” and in LoS with this model gain Marker.

entries.title: Three Jokers
entries.body: When you recruit this model you must also recruit any other models that share this trait. Models with this trait treat their rank as l¢l in game. In addition, this model can take Audacity with the Trickster trait from a friendly model with this trait that is already activated this round, counting as taking Audacity from a non-activated model.

entries.title: Tough Guy
entries.body: This model counts as two models for scoring friendly Objective cards.

entries.title: Trial
entries.body: As long as this model has a Suspect in contact, the opponent must play with the first card of their Objective deck face up, if this model gets the Suspect removed from contact, then discard the face up card.

entries.title: Troublemaker
entries.body: Search your Objective deck and add to your hand an Objective card with Type: “Sp. Shuffle your deck.

entries.title: Undercity Command
entries.body: Target friendly model within 8" of this model, and within 4" of a Sewer marker, follow the rules of using that Sewer marker immediately, but it can be moved later in the round during its activation (ignoring the Sewer penalty).

entries.title: Undercity Knowledge
entries.body: Before both groups of both crews are selected, target up to 3 friendly models with Name: Unknown. When both groups are deployed (including any other rule like Hidden), the targeted models may be deployed within 4" of a Sewer marker. If both sides have this rule, start with the player with setup initiative.

entries.title: Underestimated
entries.body: This model cannot be used by the opponent to score any card.

entries.title: Upgrades
entries.body: This model allows your crew to purchase the Equipment pieces marked as Lucius's Inventions. Only one of these equipment options are active during the game and only the active equipment option applies its effects to the equipped models. Mark the active equipment at the start of the first activation of the game. The Upgrades are: Improved Batclaw (only purchasable by models with the Batclaw/Grapple Gun trait), Improved Batlings (only purchasable by models with a weapon with the Throwing trait), Improved Bat-Armor (only purchasable by models with the Bat-Armor Mkil trait) and Improved Reinforced Gloves (only purchasable by models with the Reinforced Gloves trait).

entries.title: Vampire
entries.body: Enemy models roll 1 fewer attack die when targeting this model and when this model inflicts [[A]] with a Melee attack, remove 1 Damage marker. In addition, at the start of this model's activation, if it is not within the area effect of a Light source it may remove 1 Damage marker.

entries.title: Vampire Reign
entries.body: Enemy models within 8” suffer -1 to it's attack and defense dice rolls and may not use the Dodging rule.

entries.title: Vanguard Team
entries.body: This model places an additional Counter for the purpose of the Extermination Mission Objective cards. When Misunderstood Orders Objective card targets this model, it may Move 4.

entries.title: Vengeance
entries.body: At the start of the game, target an enemy model that cannot have the Rank: [rank icon] (unless no other option is available). Convert all the [[B]] damage this model inflicts to it to [[A]]. In addition, scored Dirty Job Objective cards provide 2 VP each (instead of 1) even if this model is not in the Gaming Area.

entries.title: Vigilante's Work
entries.body: During its activation, this model may take up to 1 Effort to perform an extra Manipulate action.

entries.title: Wah! Wah! Wah!
entries.body: All the models within 8" and LoS to this model counts as having Audacity for the Stage Play Objective card.

entries.title: Wrestler
entries.body: Keyword.

entries.title: You're Fun
entries.body: During the first Raise the Plan phase of the game, target an enemy model. When an Objective card is scored during the activation of the target, this model gains a Free Manipulate action until the end of the round.

entries.title: Bio-Chemical Barrel
entries.body: Place an Explosive template completely within 8". All models affected suffer Poison and should perform a Poison Endurance check immediately. This trait can only be used once per round.

entries.title: Blackfire Totem
entries.body: At the start of the game, place the Blackfire Totem marker within 4" of a Sewer marker. When you gain Faith points, you may place it on this marker instead of into your pool (up to 5 Faith points at the same time). When a model within 8" and LoS to this marker is going to throw dice for a Melee Attack, Defense roll, or Willpower roll, you may add X dice to that roll (where X is the number of Faith you remove from this marker). Decide it before rolling, but after the Efforts are made.

entries.title: I Am Chaos
entries.body: Discard an Objective card at random. The opponent must show you their Objective card hand. For each enemy model within 8" and LoS, choose one of those cards - the opponent must discard it.

entries.title: Lieutenant (Joker (Titan))
entries.body: If the crew contain a model with Alias (X), this model reduces its funding cost to 0 and all friendly models with Rank [rank icon] that start their activation within 8” of this model are affected by the Inspire trait of the friendly model with Alias: (X).

entries.title: Lieutenant (Chief Mackenzie)
entries.body: If the crew contain a model with Alias (X), this model reduces its funding cost to 0 and all friendly models with Rank [rank icon] that start their activation within 8” of this model are affected by the Inspire trait of the friendly model with Alias: (X).

entries.title: Lieutenant (The Penguin)
entries.body: If the crew contain a model with Alias (X), this model reduces its funding cost to 0 and all friendly models with Rank [rank icon] that start their activation within 8” of this model are affected by the Inspire trait of the friendly model with Alias: (X).

entries.title: Lieutenant (Ra's al Ghul)
entries.body: If the crew contain a model with Alias (X), this model reduces its funding cost to 0 and all friendly models with Rank [rank icon] that start their activation within 8” of this model are affected by the Inspire trait of the friendly model with Alias: (X).

entries.title: Lieutenant (The Riddler)
entries.body: If the crew contain a model with Alias (X), this model reduces its funding cost to 0 and all friendly models with Rank [rank icon] that start their activation within 8” of this model are affected by the Inspire trait of the friendly model with Alias: (X).

entries.title: Lieutenant (Black Mask)
entries.body: If the crew contain a model with Alias (X), this model reduces its funding cost to 0 and all friendly models with Rank [rank icon] that start their activation within 8” of this model are affected by the Inspire trait of the friendly model with Alias: (X).

entries.title: Lieutenant (Carmine Falcone)
entries.body: If the crew contain a model with Alias (X), this model reduces its funding cost to 0 and all friendly models with Rank [rank icon] that start their activation within 8” of this model are affected by the Inspire trait of the friendly model with Alias: (X).

entries.title: Required (Batman (Dark Knight Rises))
entries.body: This model can only be included in a crew that already contains the model with alias (X).

entries.title: Required (Batman (Michael Keaton))
entries.body: This model can only be included in a crew that already contains the model with alias (X).

entries.title: Required (Dr. Hugo Strange)
entries.body: This model can only be included in a crew that already contains the model with alias (X).

entries.title: Required (Batman (The Animated Series))
entries.body: This model can only be included in a crew that already contains the model with alias (X).

entries.title: Duo (Model)
entries.body: When this model is included in a crew that also contains the model named in parentheses that share a Rank with this model, one of them ignores the shared Rank for the purposes of crew configuration.

entries.title: Super Speed: X
entries.body: When this model is going to perform a movement action, it can draw up to X SpeedForce cards to increase its movement by 4” for each card drawn.

entries.title: Bat Family
entries.body: Keyword. This trait has no independent effect on its own; it identifies this model as a member of the Bat Family for other traits and Objective cards that reference the keyword.

entries.title: Teen Titans
entries.body: Keyword. This trait has no independent effect on its own; it identifies this model as a member of the Teen Titans for other traits and Objective cards that reference the keyword.

entries.title: Dark Influence
entries.body: When targeting a model with at least 1 [blood] damage marker with an Attack, this model gains +1 to its attack dice rolls, +1 to the Strength roll, and gains the Bleed 1 rule.

entries.title: Small Nightmare
entries.body: Rules text for this trait was not available in the source material and has not yet been transcribed.

entries.title: Control Through Fear
entries.body: Rules text for this trait was not available in the source material and has not yet been transcribed.

entries.title: Smartest Man Alive
entries.body: Rules text for this trait was not available in the source material and has not yet been transcribed.

entries.title: A Bit of Magic
entries.body: This model may assign Magic Couners to itself when performing Actions. If there is a Magical Conflux remove all the Magic Counters from this model, and this model takes just 1 Damage.

entries.title: Accelerated Venom
entries.body: When this model spends a Venom dose, instead of receiving the normal effects it may instead choose one of the following effects. 1) When this model performs a Movement action, you may place any model it came in contact with at any point 2” away. 2) [Star] damage this model deals this activation is converted to [blood] damage.

entries.title: Antagonist (2-Trickster)
entries.body: This model can roll X additional Attack/Defense dice when targeting/being targeted by a model that has the Y trait.

entries.title: Arkham Asylum Dr.
entries.body: When this model places a Suspect, target a model within 8” and LoS, make an Opposed Willpower roll against it. If successful, the target is considered to have a Mental Disorder until the end of the round.

entries.title: Artist
entries.body: Name an Objective card, draw a card from your Objective deck. If the card named is the one drawn, then you can keep it, if not discard it.

entries.title: As Blind as a Bat
entries.body: When this model Sets a Suspect and you have a ? facedown card in play from a previous action, you may reveal it and activate its Trap effect using this model as the point of origin/triggering model. Then discard that card.

entries.title: Aware of What He Did
entries.body: Search your Objective deck and add to your hand an Objective card with type: [gun]. Shuffle your deck.

entries.title: Back to the Nightmare
entries.body: Once per round, when an Objective card is removed from the Terror pile, after the current action is resolved, this model may be removed from the gaming area and use the Shadowed Nightmare trait to enter again later.

entries.title: Bio-Chemical Recharge
entries.body: Once per Round, during this model activation: Target a Poisoned FIsh or Poison Barrel event marker within 4” and place it in contact with an enemy model within 8” and LoS. This model can use immediately the Bio-Chemical Barrel trait as a free action (you must affect the enemy model).

entries.title: Bionic Eye
entries.body: This model ignores the Night rule, and may spend a Special Action while making a Ranged Attack to gain a +1 to Hit.

entries.title: Boomerang's Arsenal
entries.body: When this model uses the Throwing boomerang weapon, before rolling the dice you may choose 1 to apply to this attack. 1) Explosive Boomerang: Attack Gains Explosive and Firearm. 2) Weighted Boomerang: Once the attack action is resolved, place a Suspect in base contact with the target as a free action. 3) Bouncing Boomerang: Move this model 4” once this action has resolved.

entries.title: Brainwash
entries.body: When this model places a Suspect, target an enemy model within 4” of that Suspect. Choose one of that model’s traits. It cannot benefit from that trait until the end of the round or while that Suspect is in play.

entries.title: Breaking the Bat
entries.body: When Targeting the Enemy Boss this model Crits on a 3+. After resolving the attack action (but before removing the target) place the target Boss 4”, if the target ends in contact with a Suspect, remove the Suspect from play.

entries.title: Card Fly
entries.body: Once per round, this model may add +8” to its basic move distance, and can move in any direction (including vertically). When using this ability, the model can move over obstacles and Difficult Ground without extra cost or penalty. Up to X friendly models within 8” and LoS benefits from this trait use this round (X is equal to the number of cards discarded from your hand that shares the Suit of this model).

entries.title: Catwoman's Target
entries.body: A model with Alias (Catwoman) gains 2 Free Efforts while targeting this model with an Attack. While this model has a model with Alias (Catwoman) within 8”, it gains 1 Free Effort when Attacking and Defending against models other than that Catwoman model.

entries.title: Changing the Tempo
entries.body:
Choose one of the following. 1) This models Inspire range is increased by 4”. 2) Friendly models within this models inspire range gain 1 free effort.

This effect lasts until this trait is used again.

entries.title: Charismatic Rat
entries.body: All friendly models with Swarm within 8” and LoS gain 1 free Effort. In addition, during this model’s activation, if you have less than 3 Sewer Swarms in play, you may make 1 Effort to place 1 Sewer Swarm model within 2” of this model, then, the opponent gains 1 Pass marker.

entries.title: Cleaning the Scene
entries.body: When a friendly model within 6” removes an enemy model as a casualty it may immediately perform a Manipulate action or Draw 1 Objective card.

entries.title: Coin Flip
entries.body: Search your objective deck for a Coin card and immediately play it. Shuffle your Objective deck.

entries.title: Computer Console
entries.body: This model cannot be attacked more than once by the same model.

entries.title: Configurable Weapon
entries.body: This model can only use one of its Weapons, choose it during your first Raise the Plan phase. This model can perform an Effort and spend a Special Action during its activation to change the selected weapon.

entries.title: Counter Argument
entries.body: This trait’s effect depends on which side of the Coin is in play: Good Side) If this model performs an Attack action against a model with Audacity, this model gains an extra Manipulate action. Scarred Side) If this model performs a Manipulate action while within 4” of an enemy model with Audacity, this model gains an extra Attack action.

entries.title: Criminal Empire
entries.body: When both players end the placing of the Sewer markers, each player must place 1 Criminal Empire marker (use an Event marker) at least 8” away from all Deployment Zones. Each time a friendly model makes a Manipulate action within 4” of a Criminal Empire marker, you earn 1 Business Counter.

entries.title: Cryo-Charge
entries.body: The next Attack action performed this activation gains CRT: Freeze.

entries.title: Dark Intimidation (Spell)
entries.body: Special Action: 1 Magic Counter. Enemy models within 8” and LoS cannot make Efforts when Attacking friendly models.

entries.title: Detective Best Friend
entries.body: While this model is within 8” and LoS of a friendly model with the Detective trait, it can count as being in the position of that model when making a Manipulate Action.

entries.title: Disguise
entries.body: Remove a friendly Suspect within 4”. Then move this model 4”. Treat this model as if it had not spent an Attack action for the purpose of any traits.

entries.title: Disposable Minions
entries.body: If this model is hit by an enemy attack (any type), it may make an Effort to nominate a friendly model with the He Freed Me trait within 4” and LoS to receive the attack instead. Resolve any Damage and/or Statuses against the nominated model.

entries.title: Electromatic Control Device
entries.body: Place an Event marker within 4”. You can place within 4” of enemy models that are within 4” of that marker when it is placed. In addition all enemy models that stay within 4” of that marker during its activation suffers Enervating 2. Remover the marker at the start of the Recount phase.

entries.title: Embrace the Chaos
entries.body: After an attack in which this model scores any hits, you may take the top card from your objective deck. Immediately use the resource on that card for free and then discard it.

entries.title: Expendable Penguin 1
entries.body: This model does not count towards any Pass markers for any reason. It does not activate as normal and can not receive an Audacity marker. This model can only be hired in a crew if there is a model with the Penguin Caller and/or Hidden Penguins trait on it. When this model is removed as a Casualty, it can be placed in play again in a subsequent round with the Penguin Caller trait, removing all Damage and Statuses suffered previously.

entries.title: Expendable Penguin 2
entries.body: This model does not count towards any Pass markers for any reason. It does not activate as normal and can not receive an Audacity marker. This model can only be hired in a crew if there is a model with the Penguin Caller trait on it. When this model is removed as a Casualty, it can be placed in play again in a subsequent round with the Penguin Caller trait, removing all Damage and Statuses suffered previously.

entries.title: Explosive Sense
entries.body: All friendly models within 6” of this model, that are going to be affected by an Explosive template, impose a -1 to that roll, if any.

entries.title: Faint
entries.body: When this model becomes KO, it is also removed as a Casualty.

entries.title: Fear of the Dark
entries.body: When this model places a Suspect, target X enemy models within 8” and LoS. Each model must suffer [star] and [star] or suffers the Terror Status, at the choice of the owner. X is equal to the number of friendly suspects within 4”

entries.title: Find the Better Joker
entries.body: When a target enemy model would be removed as a Casualty within 8” of this model, you may place a new friendly model with Alias; Joker’s Victim X that has already been removed as a Casualty, in contact with the target before removing it.

entries.title: Fire Catalyst
entries.body: Enemy models within 4” suffer Damage inflicted by the Fire Status when the opponent Discards or Scores a (GUN) type card as if it had the Burn keyword.

entries.title: Flying Kick
entries.body: Until the end of this round, if, at the beginning of the attacker’s activation, the target was in a lower position than the attacker, his next melee attack gains Devastating, Push (4) and the target places a new friendly Suspect in contact ignoring the usual placement rules even if the target is KO’d due to the attack, but does not palce any suspect if it is eliminated as a casualty.

entries.title: For My Lords!
entries.body: When a friendly model within 4” that shares a Keyword with this model is the target of an Attack, this model may be the new target. Ignoring LoS and distance. During Ranged Attacks, only the modifiers that affected the original target are applied, except for the Protective trait of this model, which is applied.

entries.title: Freed
entries.body: This model can only be recruited if the crew also includes The Batman Who Laughs model.

entries.title: Gambling Time
entries.body: As long as this model is not KO, it counts as a friendly Suspect for friendly Objective cards scoring requirements.

entries.title: Gang Lord
entries.body: When this model is your Crew’s Boss, friendly models may Reveal Suspects within 3” instead of in contact.

entries.title: Growling Hound
entries.body: Target an enemy model within 8” and LoS. That model must take a Willpower roll. If unsuccessful, it must immediately Move X” directly away from this model (X is equal to the difference in willpower between the result and target model.)

entries.title: Hail to the Queen!
entries.body: This model counts as having the Spades, Clubs, Diamonds, and Hearts keywords

entries.title: Hand!!
entries.body: This model can only Set and Reveal Suspects if it is within the Inspire range.

entries.title: Harlequinade
entries.body: This model can only manipulate when she is within 8” of a friendly Alias: Batman

entries.title: He Freed Me
entries.body: This model can only be recruited if the crew also includes The Batman Who Laughs model.

entries.title: He Was the Best of Us
entries.body: Enemy models within 6” and LoS cannot make Reveal actions.

entries.title: Herald of Spades
entries.body: This model may use the King of Spades trait as long as it is within 8” and LoS to the King of Spades model.

entries.title: Hidden Penguins
entries.body:
After all groups are deployed, you may deploy within 4” from a Sewer marker models containing 'Expendable X Penguin Trait'. If the opponent also has Hidden models, start with the player with setup initiative. These models must be placed outside of LoS of all enemy models if possible, or at least 12” away from enemy models that can see it. IF NOT POSSIBLE, these models must be deployed within the usual DZ.

This Model may spend an Action to immediately perform an action with a friendly Model that has the Expendable Penguin X trait. Once per round it can perform a free action with a friendly model that has the Expendable Penguin X trait. (You cannot repeat the same action with the same penguin on the same round).

When this model places a Suspect, you may spend X Business Counters to bring back a model previously removed as a Casualty that had the Expendable Penguin X trait in contact with a Sewer marker.

entries.title: Hold 'Em Still
entries.body: When targeting an Outnumbered model, you gain +1 to hit and Bleed 2

entries.title: Holiday
entries.body: When a model is removed as a Casualty within 8”, this model may immediately Place a friendly Suspect in contact with this model or with a friendly model with Alias: Attorney Harvey Dent.

entries.title: Hunter
entries.body: When this model is going to make an Attack action against a model that is already activated this round, it may perform a free Special Action before or after resolving the attack.

entries.title: Hypnotic Radio Waves
entries.body: Choose an enemy model with rank [Henchmen] within 5” and LoS. The target immediately suffers the Hypnotize Status.

entries.title: I'm Vengeance
entries.body: Vengeance: When this model makes an Effort during an Attack action it adds an additional Attack die. Once you have scored 8 Objective cards this model loses Vengeance and gains Hope. Hope: All friendly [henchmen] that start their activation within 8” of this model are treated as though it were within range of the Inspire trait.

entries.title: If You're Good at Something...
entries.body: The Explosive Teeth markers inflicts an additional [star] marker. In addition, when this model places a Suspect, you may place it within 6” instead of in contact.

entries.title: In the End
entries.body: Once per model Activation, while this model is in the gaming area, you may spend (X) Business Counters to gain 1 of the following bonuses: 1) Flip face up a face down Underworld King card immediately. 2) At the start of a friendly model activation move up to 4” a friendly model with Rank [henchmen] within the Inspire range. 3) (X + 2) Add X additional dice to a friendly model with Rank [henchmen] within Inspire range that is going to perform a Melee Attack roll or Defense roll, declare it before the Efforts are declared.

entries.title: Incorruptible
entries.body: This model can only be included into a Crew with a Boss that has its same affiliation.

entries.title: Inside Man
entries.body: During this model’s activation you may play the Objective: Pinched Mobster as if this model had taken damage from an attack. Instead of placing the Event in contact with this model, place it in contact with an enemy model within 8” and LoS.

entries.title: Insider Agent
entries.body: Sleeper Agent’s markers within 8” of this model are moved towards the model of your choice.

entries.title: Inspiring Presence (Peacemaker)
entries.body: When this model is within 8” of a model with Alias: (X) it’s treated as though it were within range of its Bosses Inspire trait.

entries.title: Jack of Spades
entries.body: When a friendly model with the Spades trait within 8” and LoS to this model Sets a Suspect, you may Discard a card.

entries.title: King of Spades
entries.body: Another friendly model with the Spades trait performs a Move 4” and then a Tactical Action immediately. When resolved continue with this model’s activation.

entries.title: Knowledge is Power
entries.body: During this model’s activation, it gains a Free Special Action if you have looked at the opponent’s deck or hand this Round.

entries.title: Kobra Swarm
entries.body: This model cannot be recruited, and is added automatically to the crew when you hire a model with the Void Priest trait. This model gains +1 Defense skill against Ranged Attacks. Swarms do not fulfill enemy Objective criteria for making models KO or removing them as Casualties. If this model is made KO, remove it as a Casualty. If this model is in play when a friendly model Sets a Suspect, you may place this model in contact with it.

entries.title: Lazarus Pit Owner
entries.body: Once per game, at any time you can search your deck for a 'Reclaim the Lazarus Pit' objective card and add it to your hand.

entries.title: Leading From the Shadows
entries.body: If this model is the crew Boss, while this model is not on the gaming area (and not removed as a Casualty), its Inspire rule affects all of the gaming area.

entries.title: Let's Cool It for Now
entries.body: Once per round, after this model places a suspect, target another model within 4” of that suspect, it gains +1 Attack or Defence.

entries.title: Like Flies to Me
entries.body: When this model is the target of an Attack action, the attacker must treat this model’s Defense value as equal to the attacker’s Strength value.

entries.title: Listen to the Coin
entries.body: At the start of the round, gain the following based on which Coin card is in play. Twisted Coin) At the end of the Execute the Plan phase, target up to 2 Suspects and Move them 4”. Good Coin) Gain 1 Resource point this round.

entries.title: Living Arsenal
entries.body: Each time this model performs a Ranged Attack, choose one of the following special weapon rules to apply. 1) Medium Range (replace existing range rule) and Scope. 2) Explosive (reduce ROF to 1) and Anti-Tank. 3) Assault and Red Dot.

entries.title: Made Man
entries.body: If this model inflicts a KO on an enemy model, it counts as having Revealed either a friendly or enemy Suspect with a Manipulate action during its activation.

entries.title: Melee Boomerang
entries.body: This model’s Unarmed Melee Attacks inflict [blood] and [star] Damage and have the Sharp weapon special rule.

entries.title: Mind Control
entries.body: Choose an enemy model (not Vehicle) within 5” and LoS. The target immediately suffers the Hypnotize Status.

entries.title: Mindless Gas Attack
entries.body: At the start of this model’s activation target the closest enemy model. If the first action this model performs is a Movement action and it ends within X” of that enemy model, perform a free Attack action against that model.

entries.title: Molecular Control (1)
entries.body: When this model performs a movement action, you can draw up to X Speedforce cards to ignore terrain elements (Can pass through walls or buildings, but cannot end its movement inside one).

entries.title: Moment of Glory
entries.body: If this model doesn’t have an Audacity marker, at the start of its activation it may take an Effort to count as having it for that activation.

entries.title: Nature's Arm
entries.body: Until the end of the round, this model may place or reveal a Suspect marker within 4” and LoS instead of in contact. An enemy model in contact with that suspect increases the Slow Status value by (2), unless it doesn’t have it in which case it suffers the Slow (2) status.

entries.title: No More Lies
entries.body: During the activation of a friendly model with the Riddler Followers keyword, you may remove a friendly Suspect within 4” of that model. If you do, during this and the subsequent activation, the opponent cannot play Objectives as Resources.

entries.title: Order in the Court
entries.body: Friendly models affected by this model’s Inspire rule gain the following based on which Coin card is in play. Twisted Coin) Gain 1 free Effort when Attacking. Good Coin) Gain 1 free Effort when Defending.

entries.title: Paramedic
entries.body: When this model places a Suspect, it can remove up to 2 Damage from a friendly model within 4” (not Vehicle). If this ability is used to recover a model that is yet to activate that round from KO, the opponent gains a Pass marker.

entries.title: Parliament of Flowers
entries.body:
This model deploys as usual instead of using the Plants trait during the Deploys Crews step. When friendly models with the Plant trait within 8” of this model perform a Manipulate action, it can suffer 2 [blood] to place a friendly Suspect.

In addition, this model’s Tendrils attack gains Reach +X and +X to Hit rolls (where X is equal to the number of other friendly models with the Plant trait within 8” of this model).

entries.title: Pleasant Surprise
entries.body: Search your Objective deck for a copy of 'Take Back What is Ours' or 'Informant' card(s).

entries.title: Protect the Shadows
entries.body: When an enemy model performs a Reveal action on a friendly Suspect within 8” and LoS, this model may make an Effort to cancel that action.

entries.title: Protein's Shaker (Dose)
entries.body: A model may use a Protein’s Shaker when an action is declared. If it does so, for the rest of the round the model may make 1 free Effort when performing a Melee Attack or Defending.

entries.title: Pulling the Strings
entries.body: When this model places a Suspect, target another friendly model and move it 8”.

entries.title: Put More Effort
entries.body: This model places an additional Counter for the purpose of the Attempt Thwarted Objective cards.

entries.title: Queen of Spades
entries.body: Another friendly model with the Spades trait performs a Move 4” and then a Manipulate Action immediately. When resolved continue with this model’s activation.

entries.title: Raised with Venom
entries.body: This round, this model also gains 2 free Efforts while defending if it already has used a Venom Dose.

entries.title: Rapid Reload
entries.body: This model counts as having Reloaded its weapons with Reload.

entries.title: Recover the Titan
entries.body: Once per round, when an enemy model places a Suspect, nominate it as a Titan Container marker until end of the round. It is still a Suspect. Reveal 2 Objective cards from your hand and the opponent chooses one for you to play face down. During the Recount phase, if there are more friendly models than enemy models within 4 of the Titan Container, or the opponent had removed it, score that face down card. If not, discard it.

entries.title: Release the Boys!
entries.body: If this model has placed a Suspect within 4” and LoS of an enemy model this activation, you can place 2 new friendly models with Alias (Bud) and (Lou) within 4” of this model, they can be activated this round as usual and the opponent gains 2 Pass on Activations. If you do so, place a new friendly model with Alias: Harly Quinn (BTG) in contact and remove this model from the game. Transfer all Damage, Statuses, Audacity, and any Objectives that had targeted this model to the new model. If there were any unspent actions remaining, continue this activation using the new model. No Objectives may be scored as a result of this trait.

entries.title: Releasing the Dots
entries.body: Reveal an enemy Suspect within 8” and LoS.

entries.title: Reveal the Bat
entries.body: If this model has revealed an enemy Suspect this activation, place a new friendly model with Alias: Batman (Robert Pattinson) in contact and remove this model from the game. Transfer all Damage, Statuses, Audacity, and any Objectives that had targeted this model to the new model. If there were any unspent actions remaining, continue this activation using the new model. No objectives may be scored as a result of this trait.

entries.title: Seasonal Criminal
entries.body: At the end of every round, check the total Victory Points scored by all players. For every 12 VP scored, Calendar man gains one of the following benefits, advancing one step for each 12 scored.

entries.title: Shadows Command
entries.body: Target another friendly model within 8” and place it in contact with a friendly Suspect. Then remove that Suspect. That model may immediately perform an Attack action. If this attack is a Melee attack, it may target an enemy up to 4” away and in LoS.

entries.title: Shapeshifting Gorilla Profile
entries.body: This model cannot be recruited to your crew, and can only be placed by a model with the Shapeshifting trait. When this is placed, the Obstinate trait uses 3 efforts instead of 1.

entries.title: Shapeshifting Hawk Profile
entries.body: This model cannot be recruited to your crew, and can only be placed by a model with the Shapeshifting trait. When this is placed, this model may use the Fly trait as a free action.

entries.title: Shapeshifting Human Profile
entries.body: See other shapeshifting profiles. When used, this model can reveal a suspect marker within 3” and LoS instead of in contact.

entries.title: Shapeshifting Tiger Profile
entries.body: This model cannot be recruited to your crew, and can only be placed by a model with the Shapeshifting trait. When this is placed, this model deals damage it can end activation in contact with that model.

entries.title: Showing the Ropes
entries.body: If this model is the target for the Objective: Recovering the Juice, target another friendly model within 6” with rank [henchmen] to also count as the target model.

entries.title: Stealthy Cats
entries.body: Move each friendly Cat marker in play up to 4”. For each marker that ends this movement within 4” of this model, this model may move up to 2” for free.

entries.title: Suit of Sorrows
entries.body: When Attacking or Defending, this model gains 1 free Effort and reduces the total number of damage markers it receives from attacks by 1.

entries.title: Super-Sight
entries.body: This model ignores the Blind Status. In addition, once per round, during one action, it can make up to 3 free Efforts.

entries.title: Suspicious Plant
entries.body: This model may place Suspects ignoring the Plant trait restriction.

entries.title: Tamer Device
entries.body: Target an enemy model within 8”, move all friendly Sewer Swarm models 6” towards that model. Make an attack with 1 of those models against the target if able, with +1 Attack dice for each other Sewer Swarm in contact with the target.

entries.title: Team Player
entries.body: When you play a Teamwork Action Objective card you can move this model 4”.

entries.title: The Dude
entries.body: Once per game, this model may ignore a rule targeting it.

entries.title: The Good Command
entries.body: When you score an Objective card, an enemy model within 4” of a Sewer marker suffers the Quarry (X) Status (where X is the VP of the scored card). If you inflict this effect against another model by the use of this trait, the previous model loses their Quarry (X) Status.

entries.title: The Main Man
entries.body: One use only. When a model ends an Action, you can use this trait. Then, until the end of the round, this model gains +1 to its Attack and Defense skills and 3 free Efforts while Attacking and Defending.

entries.title: The One and Only Joker
entries.body: At the start of this model’s activation, if there are no enemy models within 4” you may search your Objective deck for an Objective card named 'Let Them In On The Joke'. Reveal it and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Objective deck.

entries.title: The Quiver
entries.body: When this model starts its activation, choose one of the following affects. You may not choose the same option more than once: 1) Add to this round Ranged Attacks Stunned. 2) Add to this round Ranged Attacks Knocked Down + Blunt (2). 3) Add to this round Ranged Attacks +2 RoF. 4) Until end of the round, this model gains the Grapple Gun rule.

entries.title: The Tomorrow Knight
entries.body: At the start of this model’s activation, you can search your Objective deck for a copy of the 'None of you are Safe' objective card.

entries.title: This Is My City
entries.body: Target an enemy model that has LoS to a friendly Suspect within 8” of it. That model suffers the Hypnotize Status. If that model is a [henchmen] without the Incorruptible trait, before the Willpower roll is made, you may spend $100 Black Money to have it automatically fail.

entries.title: Titan Addict
entries.body: When this model uses a Titan Dose, ignore up to 2 Damage markers per source of damage until the end of the round. If this model receives 3 [blood] damage while using a Titan Dose, the benefits of the Titan Dose ceases to apply. In addition, this model may use more than one Titan Dose in the game.

entries.title: Tracking Device
entries.body: Until the end of the round, each time an enemy model ends a Movement Action within 8”, you may Move a friendly model within Inspire Range 4” at the end of that activation.

entries.title: Trap Master
entries.body: Once per round, when an enemy model reveals a Suspect within 8” and in LoS with this model, that enemy model suffers [star] + [blood] Damage and Enervating (1) and Slow (4) Status.

entries.title: Treasure Hunter
entries.body: When this model inflicts the Steal Status, the opponent must target 1 of their Suspects in play. That Suspect is also now a Treasure for you. This model can Reveal as a free action a Treasure and when doing it, you may search for any card on your Objective deck and add it to your hand.

entries.title: True Psychopath
entries.body: When a model within 8” is removed as a Casualty, you may place two [circle w/ x] on top of the Psychopaths Objective card instead of 1.

entries.title: Umbrella's Knout Gas
entries.body: Target an enemy within 4” and LoS. That model must take an Endurance Roll. If not successful, it suffers the Enervating (3) Status.

entries.title: Unmask the Truth
entries.body: When this model Reveals an enemy Suspect, enemy models with the Intel Support trait receive an additional Disruption token.

entries.title: Vendetta
entries.body: When this model damages an enemy with an action, it immediately Reveals an enemy Suspect within 8” of the target.

entries.title: Visor Projections
entries.body: At the start of this model’s activation, choose one of the following to apply to this model’s weapons. 1) Gain the Handy trait. 2) Gain the Reach (8) trait. 3) Change the damage type of the weapon to [blood].

entries.title: Walking Plant
entries.body: This model does not benefit from its Action Zone to perform Attack and Manipulate actions. In addition, if this model starts its activation within 8” from a friendly model with the Elite Boss (Plants) trait, it removes 1 Damage, if not, it suffers 1 [blood]

entries.title: Walking Suspects
entries.body: When this model performs the Manipulate action to Place or Reveal a Suspect, it is immediately removed as a Casualty.

entries.title: War Scream
entries.body: All models within 8” and LoS with less Willpower than this model suffers Scared.

entries.title: Widespread Corruption
entries.body: Target an enemy Suspect within 8” and LoS. Place a friendly Suspect in contact with it and remove the enemy Suspect.

entries.title: Burn (X)
entries.body: Spend X Resource Points to play this Resource. Discard the card from your hand and place it on the bottom of your Objective deck.

entries.title: Trap
entries.body: This Resource cannot be played normally. When the card is revealed through its Trap trigger, resolve the Trap effect. This does not count as playing a Resource that round. The card does not enter the Spent Resource pile; if scored, place it with the scored cards, otherwise discard it.

entries.title: Boosted (X)
entries.body: When making an attack with this weapon, roll X additional attack dice.

entries.title: CRT (X)
entries.body: A model normally scores a Critical Result by rolling a natural 6 on its Strength die, although some traits can change the required result. On a Critical Result, this weapon inflicts the Status listed in parentheses.

entries.title: Pull (X)
entries.body: The affected model is moved directly towards the attacker X”.

entries.title: High Caliber
entries.body: This weapon’s Strength die is the last that must be removed from the attack if the target is within effective range.

entries.title: Motion (X)
entries.body: When using this weapon, if any hits are scored the wielder may immediately Move X”.

entries.title: Acceleration
entries.body: When this weapon is used against a target that is not within 8”, the target cannot use the Dodge trait. Also, the first die that would cause it to lose the Strength die becomes a normal Attack die. Any further dice loss occurs as normal.

entries.title: Concealed
entries.body: To use this weapon, you first need to perform 2 Efforts.

entries.title: Limited Attack
entries.body: An attack with this weapon inflicts damage only once, regardless of the number of successful Hits, and does not inflict Knocked Down when scoring a CRT.

entries.title: True Fear
entries.body: When scoring any number of successful Hits during an Attack, add 1 Fear card to your Objective deck.

entries.title: Terror
entries.body: When an enemy model suffers the Terror Status, draw 1 Objective card from the top of your opponent’s Objective deck and place it facedown in your Terror pile. When an enemy model would make an Attack dice roll, Defense dice roll, or a Willpower roll, the opponent may reveal up to 3 cards from your Terror pile. Apply the Poison Status a number of times equal to the number of cards revealed. If the model already has, or reaches, Poison (4) as a result of this action, it immediately makes a Poison test. After applying this Status, put the cards on the bottom of the original owner’s deck. If you cannot draw, the enemy model instead suffers [[B]] [[B]] Damage.

entries.title: Infected
entries.body: If the target suffers damage as a result of an Attack made with this weapon, it becomes Infected.

entries.title: Exposure
entries.body: For each additional successful hit after the first, the target suffers 1 additional damage marker (any type).

entries.title: Cryo-Weapon
entries.body: After the first successful hit, choose another model and 1 Suspect within 2” of the target. The chosen model suffers 1 hit from that weapon (which cannot trigger this rule again), and the Suspect becomes Frozen.

entries.title: Small Caliber
entries.body: This weapon loses 2 dice instead of 1 if the target is not in effective range.

entries.title: Recoil (X)
entries.body: When using this weapon, after resolving the attack, the wielder immediately Moves X” directly away from the target or template position.

entries.title: Shield Breaker
entries.body: Rules text not yet documented — the description was blank in the submitted trait list. Update this entry once the official wording is available.

entries.title: Healing Radiance
entries.body: A friendly model within 4” of the target of the attack removes up to 1 Damage.

entries.title: Suggest
entries.body: If any Damage is dealt with this weapon, Set an enemy Suspect in contact with the target (if able).
